༄ga /'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄7na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rā dzasa.a ba bsnyed ka nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / mchod pa dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang /rgyal po'i mthu chen pos rol mo'i sil snyan len pa mang po dang / bram ze dang /khyim bdag brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mnyan du yod pa nas byung ste/63—207

rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der song nas de bzhon du rung ba'i sa ji srid pa de srid du bzhon pa la zhon te/bzhon pa las babs nas rkang gis kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis shing zhig gi drung na bcom ldan 'das mdzes pa/blta7na sdug pa②/ dbang po zhi ba/ thugs zhi ba/ dul ba dang / zhi gnas mchog brnyes pa/ dul ba dang zhi ba'i mchog dang ldan pa/ bsrungs pa/dbang po dul ba/ skyes bu glang po/ skyes bu seng ge/ skyes bu khyu mchog /skyes bu cang mkhyen pa/ mtsho ltar dang zhing chagasal la rtog pa mi mnga' ba/skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu gertsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byadasnyibazang posrebargyad cus sku rnam par mdzes pa/ gser gyi mchod sdong ltar mngon par 'phags pa dpal gyis 'bar zhing bzhugs par rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ches yid dga' zhing sems mngon par dad nas des rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ yul la dbang ba'i mthu thob pa'i rgyal po'i mtshan ma lnga gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ ze'u ka dang /gdugs dang / ral gri dang / bsil yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / lham ri mo can de dag bor nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas ⑧bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci nas bdag gi yun ring po'i don dang / sman pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ba de ltar bcom 63—208

ldan 'das kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ de ltar bde bar gshegs pas bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa legs so legs so/ /rgyal po chen po de'i phyir chos kyis rgyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o/ /khyod chos dang 'thun7par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thun⑧par gi⑧mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i blon po gang la la zhig chos spangs nas chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed na de tshe 'di nyid la ya rabs kyis smad par bya ba yin no/ /phyis kyang 'gyod par 'gyur ro/ /lus zhig ste shi nas ngan song ngan 'gro log par lhung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i blon po gang la la zhig chos ma yin pa spangs te/ chos kyis rgyal srid byed kyisadu/ chos ma yin pas ni mi byed nadu/ de tshe 'di nyid la ya rabs kyis bsngags par bya ba yin no/ /phyis 'gyod par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /lus zhig nas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na pha ma ni bu la snying brtse bas rtag tu bde zhing 'tshe ba med par 'dod do/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du rgyal pos kyang bran phoshedang /bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang /blon po dang / gnyen dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo dag rtag tu bsdu ba rnam bzhis bsdu bar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa dang /snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don 'thun⑧pa'o/ /de ltar bran 63—209

phoshedang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang / gnyen dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo sdudakhupa'i rgyal po des don gnyis bsdus shing 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ tshe 'di'i dang / tshe phyi ma'i'o①/ /rgyal po chen po de la rgyal po ni pha ma dang mtshungs so/ /bran lo0dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tshosnyib dang / mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang / gnyen dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo ni rgyal po'i bu dang / bu mo dang mtshungs so/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste dper na skyes pa'am/ bud med gcig gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na kun dga' ra ba nyams dga' ba dang / ri nyams dga' ba dang / nags tshal nyams dga' ba dang / chu klung nyams dga' ba dang / rdzing bu nyams dga' ba dang / yul nyams dga' ba dang / khang bzangasarkyunyams dga' ba dag mthong ba las de sad na ci yang mi mthong ngo / /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du/rgyal srid dang / srog dang / ⑧rgyal srid kyi bde ba dang / rgyal po'i dbang phyug gi bde ba dang / 'dod pa'i bde bshedang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi bde ba gang yin pa dag kyang rmi lam dang 'dra'o/ /'di lta ste/ glang po che dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / dpung bu chung dang / bud med dang /khang khyim dang / chung ma dam pa dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang /rtsis pa dang / blon po chen po dang / sgo ba dang / 'khor dang / pha dang /ma dang / spun dang / sring mo dang / chung ma dang / bu dang / bu mo dang /na tshod dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang / gnyen dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo dang /63—210

'gronanyebu dang / gser dang / nor bu dang / rin po che dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya7dang / dung dang zha man shel dang / byi(ru dang / sa le sbramasnyedang / dngul dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / bang ba dang / mdzod la sogs pa de dag thams cad bor nas 'gro dgos so/ /de dag thams cad kyang mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ yid brtanashedu mi rung ba/ 'gyur ba'i chos can/ yun thung ba/ mi gnas pa/ g.yo ba/'gul ba/ 'jig pa/ skad cig pa/ mthar sdig pa/ zad pa dang /dengs pa'i sgo/ mthar 'jig pa'i chos can/ mthar 'gyes pa/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa/ gnod pa dang bcas pa/ mya ngan dang / 'khrug pa mang ba/'drul ba/ 'brul ba/ 'chad pa/ 'bye ba/ 'jomasalgepa/ rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can te/ rgyal po chen po de lta bas na mi rtag par lta7zhing zad pa dang dengs pa'i sgo yin par blta bar bya ste 'chi bas 'jigs skrag par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po khyod chos kho nas rgyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o/ /khyod chos dang 'thun par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thun7par ni mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste dper na shing rnams las me tog dag byung nas 'bras bu rnams 'byung 8bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu dag tu gyur nas 'bras bu dag kyang yal bar 'gyur ro/ /lo ma sngon por gyur pa las ser por 'gyur ro/ /ser por gyur nas yang thams cad du med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste dper na me'i phung po chen po 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba/ kun tu rab tu mched cing 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa ji ltar yun ring yang 'bar nas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma dang 63—211

zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba/ 'di ltar dbang che b.ratugrags pa/ rang gi gzi brjid kyis rnam par mdzes pa 'di gnyis kyang 'jig rten 'di snang bar byas nas nub par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu sprin sdud dam/char 'bebs pa dag 'brug bsgrags/ sgra phyung ste/ nam mkha' khebs par byas nas char gyi rgyun phab kyang char pa tha mar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du rgyal srid kyi bde ba dang / rgyal po'i dbang phyug gi bde ba dang /'dod pa'i bde ba dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi bde ba rnams kyang rmi lam dang 'dra'o/ /'di lta ste/ glang po che dang / rta pasadang / shing rta dang /dpung bu chung dang / bud med dang / khang khyim dang / chung ma dam pa dang /gzhon nusnyedang / blon po dang / rtsis pa dang / blon po chen po dang / sgo ba dang / 'khor dang / pha dang / ma dang / spun dang / sring mo dang /④chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo dang / na tshod dang / bran phobadang /bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang /blon po dang / gnyen dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo dang / 'gron bu dang /gser dang / nor bu dang / rin po che dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya7dang ske/ dung dang / man shel dang / byi7ru dang / sa le sbram dang /dngul dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang ske/ bang ba la sogs pa de dag thams cad bor nas 'gro dgos so/ /de dag thams cad kyang mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ yid brtan du mi rung ba/'gyur ba'i chos can/ yun thung ba/ mi gnas pa/ g.yo ba/ 'gul ba/mthar 'jig pa/ skad cig7pa/ mthar sdig pa/ zad pa dang dengs pa'i sgo/63—212

mthar 'gyes pa'i chos can/ 'jiganyepa dang bcas pa/ gnod pa dang bcas pa/ mya ngan dang / 'khrug pa mang ba/ 'drul ba/ 'brul ba/ 'chad pa/ 'bye bzha 'gyes pa/ 'jig pa'i chos can te/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis mi rtag par blta zhing zad pa dang / dengs pa'i sgor blta bar bya ste/ 'chi bas 'jigs skrag par bya'o/ /chos kyishergyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o/ /khyod chos dang 'thun⑧par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thunakhupar0mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste dper na phyogs bzhi nas ri chen po sra ba/ brtan pa/ snying po dang ldan pa/ ma zhig pa/ ma gas pa/ 'phan med pa/ shin tu mkhregs pa/ gcig tu stug pa bzhisheganam la reg cing sarnyuzlog ste/ rtswa dang / shing dang /dzin shing gel pa dang /yal ga dang / lo ma thams cad dang / sems can srog chags 'byung po thams cad phye mar 'thag cing 'ong ba de dag las ni mgyogs pas 'bros nyu2pa'am/stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bzlog pa'am/8 sngags dang / rdzas dang / sman rnams kyis bzlog par bya bar sla ba ma yin no/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du 'jigs pa chen po bzhi po 'di dag 'ong ste/ de dag las mgyogs pas 'bros pa'amanya/ stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bzlog pa'am/rdzas dang / sngags dang / sman rnams kyis bzlog par bya bar sla balgem yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / rgyad pa'o//rgyal po chen po rga ba ni dar la bab pa 'joms shing 'ong / na brnyani nad med pa 'joms shing 'ong / rgyad pa ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'joms shing〈kye'ong / 'chi ba ni srog 'joms shing 'u'ong ste/ de dag lasamanyamagyogs 63—213

pas 'bros pa'am/ stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bzlog pa'am/rdzas dang / sngags dang / sman rnams kyis zhi bar bya bar sla ba ma yin no/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na ri dgas7kyi rgyal po seng ge ri dgas7kyi tshogs kyi nang du zhugs nas ri dgas7bzung ste/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bya ba byed do/ /ri dgas de ni stobs po che'i kha mi bzadasnyipas bzung bas dbang med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du 'chi bdag gikhugasal shing gis zug ste/ rgyags pa dang ni bral/ mgon ni med/ skyabs ni med/dpung gnyen ni med/ gshis ni 'jig /tshigs ni 'bye 'bral/ sha dang khrag ni skamasal/ lus ni nad kyis gdungs/ sgom ni skom/ bzhin ni 'gyurani/rkang lag ni g.yo ba/ las ni mi nus/ mthu ni med/ kha chu dang / snabs dang / gcin dang / ngan skyugs kyis nishelus la gos/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi dbang po dag ni 'gags/skyigs bu ni 'byung / sgra ngar ngar po ni 'thon⑩/ sman pas ni bor/ sman dang / kha zas dang / bza' ba dang / thug pa thams cad kyis ni gles la bor te/ 'gro ba gzhan dag tu 'gro bar mal gyi tha ma la ni nyal/ thog ma med pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba'i 'khor ba'i rgyud du ni nub/ srog ni cung zad cig lasalgegashin rje'i mis ni 'jigs skrag /byur gyi dbang du ni song / dbugs rgyu ba ni chad/ kha dang sna ni gdangs/ so ni gtsigasatso/ sbyin pa sbyin no zhes de skad gsol ba ni 'debs/ las kyi srid pa nas yang srid pa la ni0'jug /gcig pu gnyis su med cing grogs ni med/'jig rten 'di ni 'dor/ 'jig rten pha rol du ni 'gro/ /skyas chen po ni 63—214

'degs①/ mun pa chen por ni zhugs/ g.yang sa chen por ni lhung / khrod stug por ni〈'jug /dgon pa chen por ni 'gro/ rgya mtsho chen pos ni khyer/las kyi rlung gis ni bdas/ sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su ni 'grol/ g.yul ngo chen por ni 'jug /gdon chen pos ni zin/ nam mkha' la ni 'chel/ pha ma dang / phu nu dang / sring mo dang / bu dang bu mos ni bskor/ dbugs ni 'chad/ nor bgo0bsha' bya zhes ni zer/ kyi hud ma/ kyi hud pha/ kyi hud bu zhes ni zer/ skra ni zhig ste/ sbyin pa dang / dka' thub dang / chos 'ba' zhig ⑧grogs su gyur pa na/ chos ma gtogs par skyabs gzhan med/mgon gzhan med/ gnasalgegazhan med/ dpung gnyen gzhan med do/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na chos ni gling dang / gnas dang / mgon dang / rtonashepar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste dper na grang bas nyen pa la me dang / mes rab tu gdungs par gyur pa la me gsod ⑧pa dang /tsha bas nyen pa la bsil ba dang / 'gron7po ngal ba la ni grib ma dang / rlung bsil ba dang / skom pa la chu bsil ba dang / lam du zhugs pa la bzhon pa dang / nyal ba la mal 'jam po dang / skom pa la chu grang mo dang / shin tu bkres pa la zas bzang po dang / mya ngan gyis non pa la dbugs 'byin pa dang rka/ gdungs pa la sim par byed pa dang / dgon par lam stor ba la lam mtshon pa dang / nad kyis btab pa la sman pa dang / sman dang / nad g.yog byed pa dang / chus khyer ba la gzings dang / 'dam du bying ba la 'jus dang / rgal dka'apheb la zam pa dang / nyam nga ba la 'bab stegs dang ske/ mun khung na sgron mnyedang / rgya mtsho chen po la gru dang / lhags pas 63—215

nyen pa la rlung med pa'i gnas dang / yul gzhan du song ba la lam rgyagasatudang ske/ dbul po la nor dang / byed par 'dod pa la grogs dang / gcadakhupar 'dod pa la lag chasnyedang / gzhig par 'dod pa la rdo rje dang / g.yul ngor zhugs pa la go cha dang / 'jigs pa la stobs dang ldan pa'i grogs dang /'thab pa la dpung gnyen dang / dog pa la go 'byed pa dang / mu ge la nor dang ldan pa dgasemagon dang / skyabs dang / gnas dang / rten du gyur pa de bzhin du rgyal po chen po 'chi bdag gi gsal shing gis zug ste/ rgyags pa dang ni bral/ mgon ni med/ skyabs ni med/ dpung gnyen ni med/gshis ni 'jig /tshigs ni 'bye 'bral/ sha dang khrag ni skamasadu/ lus ni nad kyis gdungs/ sgom ni skom/ bzhin ni 'gyur/ rkang lag ni g.yo ba/las ni mi nus/ mthu ni med/ kha chu dang / gcin dang / ngan skyugs kyis ni lus la gos/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid kyi dbang po dag ni 'gagasal/ skyigs bu ni 'byung / sgra ngar ngar po ni 'thonani / sman pas ni bor/ sman dang zha kha zas dang / bza' ba dang /zas dang / thug pa thams cad kyis ni gles la bor te/ 'gro ba gzhan du 'gro bar mal gyi tha ma la ni nyal/ thog ma med pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba'i 'khor ba'i rgyud du ni nub/ srog ni cung zad cig las(me/gshin rje'i mis ni 'jigs skrag /byur gyi dbang du ni tu)song / dbugs rgyu ba ni 'chad8/ kha dang sna ni gdangs8/ so ni gtsigs/ sbyin pa sbyin no zhes de skad gsol ba ni 'debs/ las kyis srid pa nas yang srid pa la ni 'jug /gcig pu gnyis su med cing grogs ni med/ 'jig rten 'di ni 'dor/63—216

'jig rten pha rol du ni 'gro/ skyas7chen po ni 'degs②/ mun pa chen por ni zhugs/ g.yang sa chen por ni lhung / khrod stug por ni 'jug /dgon pa chen por ni 'gro/ rgya mtsho chen pos ni khyer/ las kyi rlung gis ni bdas/ sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su nishe'agro ba na/ chos ma gtogs par mgon gzhan med/ skyabs gzhan med/ dpung gnyen gzhan med do/ /rgyal po chen po chos ni de'i tshe de'i dus na gling chen po dang / gnas dang / mgon dang /skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / rton par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe 'di snyam0du sems te/ kyikhuhud gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ phyogs gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ gang du yongs su 'dzin par byed par 'gyur/bdag gi mar ni su zhig 'gyur snyam pa las/ des sems can dmyal bar skye bar mthong bar gyur na/ 'di lta ste/ mnar med pa dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba la sogs pa'i sems can dmyal ba rnams su lo mang po lo brgya phrag mang po/ lo stong phrag mang por sdug bsngal chen po/ sdug bsngal mi bzadasnyepa / drag po/ rtsub pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong ste/ ji srid du sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las yong7thams cad du zad cing byang bar ma gyur pa/ de srid du 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye bar mthong bar gyur na 'di lta ste/rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du nya rlon dang / nyalorlon mid la sogs pa srog chags gcig gis gcig gsod pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / dbang med par skye'o/ /bdag yi dgas7kyi nang du skye bar mi 'gyur ram snyam na 'di lta ste/ lo mang po dang ske/ lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo7stong phrag mang por chu'i sgra yang mi thos 63—217

na mthong ba lta ci smos par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis mi rtag par blta zhing zad pa dang dengs par blta bar bya ste 'chi bas 'jigs skragatupar bya'o/ /chos kyis rgyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o/ /khyod chos dang 'thun⑧par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thun⑧par ni mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyi lus 'di 'di ltar legs par yongs su bsrungasaphulegs par yongs su btsas pa yang 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing shin tu yun ring por bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang ba dang / ngoms par 'gyur ba/bsod pa gtsang ma mang pos tshim par byas te bskyed bskyed pa yang tha ma'i mal na 'dug pa'i tshe sman pas bor zhing / sman dang / kha zas dang / bza' ba dang ske/ thug pas kyang gles la bor nas/ bkres pa dang / skom pas nyen cing yid mi bde bar 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar khyod kyis lus bkrus shing bskus te/ bdug0pas bsgos/ me tog gi dri zhim po bsgos kyang gdon mi za bar dus su rang bzhin gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i dri nga ba 'byungashebar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar yul ka shi ku'i⑧ras dang /mon dar dang / du gu la'i ras dang / dar dang / 'dabalgem dang / bal gos dang / so ras la sogs pa'i gos kyi bye brag gis g.yogs kyang tha ma'i mal na 'dug pa'i tshe snum rnam pa mang po dang / chus reg cing gos dri ma can gyon cing 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar khyod khyim na bud med kyi nang natshwanye'adug btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug ste/ bud med kyi tshogs kyis7bskor cing / garachadang / glu dang / rol mo'i sil snyan byed/63—218

pheg rdob pa dang / pi bangatudang / gling bu len/ rnga brdungakhuzhing yid bde bar rtse dga' ste/ dga' mgur spyod pa yang 'chi bas 'jigs skrag nas shin tu yid mi bde zhing 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po desaltar khyod khyim gyi nang na spos dri zhim po'i bsku bas ni bskus/ gtan0pa ni bcug /skar khung ni legs par bcad/ byug pa mang pos ni byugs/ 'bru mar dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i mar me ni 'bar/ dar gyi lda ldi mang po ni bres/ me tog dri zhim po'i sil ma mang pos ni chal par bkang / pog por nas ni dubadugs/khri'i rtsa ba gserabadang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya las ni byas/ pa ti ka dang / dri'unyerngog gi stan dngashe/ stan nang tshangs can dang / za 'og gi stan dang / yul ka ling ka pa'i stan dang / steng du gding7ba dang / de'i steng du gding7bas ni bkab/ g.yas g.yon du dar dmar po'i sngas ni bzhag pa'i khri la nyal ba yang bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / wa dang / ro dang / sha dang / rus pa dang / skra dang / khrag dang / zhagacadang / chu ser dang /rnag gi gnas mchog tu 'jigs su rung ba'i dur sa chen por bor nas/ lus g.yo ba med cing sa la nyal du gdon mi za'o/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar yang khyod glang po che'i bya la kha'am/ rta'i rgyab bam/ shing rta la zhon te/ dung dang / rnga dang / rdza rnga dang / khar rnga dang / rol mo sil snyan gyi bye brag len pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan ni bsgreng / bsil yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / rnga yab dang / shing ta la las byas pa ni g.yob cing / glang po che dang / rta pa dang /dpung bu chung du ma ni phyi bzhin 'brang / rgyal bu dang / bram zes bslab pa 63—219

phog pa'i blon po dang / mdun na 'don dang / skye0bo thal mo sbyar ba brgya stong du mas ni phyag bya zhing rgyal bar spyon cig /rgyal b.rashespyon cig ces snyan par rjod51de phyir 'byungaphub yang ring po mi thogs par g.yo ba med cing mal du shi nas mi bzhis bteg ste/ pha dang / ma dang / phu nu dang / sring mo dang /chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang /las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / tshal za dngakyi/ blon po dang /grong khyer ba'i skye bo dag mya ngan gyi dbang du song ste/ lag pa btegs nas brang rdung 6)zhing mchog tu snying rje bar kyi hud bu/ kyi hud mgon po/ kyi hud pho bol / kyi hud jo bo zhes ngu zhing zhabs 'bringasab dang / grong khyer ba'i skye bo dag gis 'jigs pa dang bcas par mthong ste/ grong khyer gyi lho phyogs kyishesgor phyung nas sa'i 'og tu bcug gam/ 'brog7 dgon par sa'i 'og tu bcug kyang rung ske/ bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / wa la sogs pas zos shing rus pa de dag mes bsregs sam/ chur skyuraloram/ sa'i 'og tu bcug kyang rlung dang /nyi ma dang / char pas phye mar byas te/ phyogs phyogs su 'thor zhing / de nyid du rul bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar sems can thams cad kyi lus kyang 'di bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po 'du byed thams cad ni de ltar mi rtag pa/ de ltar mi brtan pa/ de ltar yid brtan du mi rung ba/ de ltar 'gyur ba'i chos can te/ yun thung ba/ mi gnas pa/ g.yo ba/ 'gul ba / skad cig pa/ mthar sdig pa zad pa dang / dengs pa'i sgo/ mthar 'gyes pa/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa/ gnod pa dang bcas pa/ mya ngan dang 'khrug pa mang ba/ 'drul ba/ 'brul ba/ 'chad pa/ 'bye ba/63wa 220

'thor ba/ rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can no/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na mi rtag par blta zhing zad pa dang / dengs pa'i sgor blta bar bya ste/ 'dod chags kyis ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang gis mi snang ba dang / gti mug gis ma rmongs pa dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gi bde ba la ma chags pa dang /'dod pa'i bde ba dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi bde ba la ma chags pa dang /mi rtag par lta ba dang / bag yod pa dang / ma chags pa dang / mi brkam pa dang / ma zhen7pa dang / ma mosalgepa dang / srog snyems pa med par 'chi bas 'jigs skrag par bya'o/ /chos kho nas rgyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o/ /khyod chos dang 'thun⑧par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thun0par ni mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang / rab tu rnyed pa dang / sogs0pa dang / kun tu sogasalgepa dang /sten pas 'dod pa dag gis ngoms par nga mi smra ste/ gang dag 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis ngoms par 'gyur ba de dag ni ngoms so/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyisakhureg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang ske/ mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyisaphung po chen po 'ba' zhig7'di yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la ma rig 63—221

pa 'gags pasatu'adu byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags pas tshor bku'agag /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gags pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang /mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhigashe'adi yang 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na/ 'dodakyichags kyis ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang gis mi snang ba dang /gti mug gis mashermongs pa dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug dang / dbang gi dregs pa med par chos kho nas rgyal srid gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni mi bya'o//khyod chos dang 'thun0par gyis shig /chos ma yin pa dang 'thunakhupar ni mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po 'dod pa rnams kyi rnyed pa dang /rab tu rnyed pa dang / ngoms par mi 'gyur ba'i bar du nga smra ste/ rab tu ngoms par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes nga smra'o/ /gang dag 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis ngoms par gyur pa de dag ni ngoms so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /mi nyid 'di ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'chi bdag rab tu mi bzadashe'ong / /khyod kyi tshe 'di mi brtan gyisal/ /rgyal po bag med ma byed cig /nor ni gtang gi lus ni bsrung bar bya/ /yan lag gtang gi srog ni bsrung bar bya/ /nor dang yan lag rnams 63—222

dang de bzhin srog /thams cad gtang gi 'dir ni chos bsrung ngo / /chos spyod pa ni chos la srung bar byed/ /dper na dbyar dus gdugs chen bsrungatub bzhin/ /chos spyod pa yi phan yon 'di yin te/ /chos spyod pa ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro'o/ /chos ma yin pa spyod cing bag med pa/ /'di nas shi 'phos ngan 'gro mi bzadaku'agro/ /gang du gnas na 'chi bas mi tshugs pa③/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang ma yin rgya mtsho'i nang ma yin/ /ri yi phug tu zhugs kyang mi phan no/ /'chi bas 'jigs pa chen po de dag ni/ /phung po 'jig cing srog 'gag shes gyis la/ /'chi med thob par khyod ni mos par gyis//mya ngan 'das thob phyin chad 'chi mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs tedu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rdzogs sonya// // sgorgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de 0ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad ⑦kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa ni63—223

cilta ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang /① dge bsnyen ma byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang yang thabs cig go/ /de na ②de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston pa ni 'di lta ste/ 'khor bzhi po rnams kyi nang du 'di lta bu'i chos kyi gtam/srid yod bde dang sdug bsngal te/ /zad dang gtanasayod ma yin no/ /de ltasarnyubade sdug spangs pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu bde/ /zhes ston par mdzad do/ /'dir smras pa/ ci'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so zhes bya ba de'i gtan tshigs brjod par bya ste/ ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor mang po dang / 'khor mang po'i gtso bo dang ldan pa/ 'khor rtag tu mi phyed pa/ rmad du byung ba'i chos dang cho 'phrul mang po mnga' ba'o zhes sgra grags/ gal te de lta na ni 'khor lnga brgyar mishezad na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bye ba can du 'gyur ro/ /yang 'dir smras pa / 'dul7ba thams cad la mnga' sgyur ba'i stobs mnga' bas mnyan yod na de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so zhes tshig tu gsungs ya/ ci dper na mas bu khur du thogs te rang gi yul nas yul gzhan du 'gro ba na rang gi bu spro bsring ba'i phyir bu grong 'di nye'o zhes bya ba'i tshig smra ba de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba rjes su srung ba rnams dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang thabs cig go zhes bya ba yin nam zhe na/ de dag la smras pa/ dge slong dag chos kyi gtam 'di ni lan gsum du bzlas pa yin te/ de bas na dge slong lnga brgya tsam zhes bya ba de dag ni skyes bu'i gtso bo 63—228

rnams yin par rig par bya7ste/ don gzhan ni ma yin no/ /dper na khyu mchog re re la yangasab lang gi tshogs yod pa bzhin du skyes bu'i gtso bo la yang slob ma lnga brgya yod de/ re re la yang slob ma lnga brgya lnga brgya yod do/ /de lta bas na nyan thos chen po lnga brgya tsam zhes bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'od srung chen po dang / de bzhin du kun dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos chen po lnga brgya tsam po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ glang po chen po/ cang shes pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid parashekun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su thob pa/ mi slob pa rnams dang / slob pa rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la gnas pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa rnams dang zag pa zad pa'i chos can gyi dge slong gi tshogs du ma dag dang / yon tan brgya stong dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med cing dpag tu med padu/ phyogs bcu nas lhags pa gang yin pa de dag gi tshad kyang 'jam dpal ma gtogs pa rtsis mkhan nam/ rtsis mkhan gyi slob mas kyang bgrang bar mi nus shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mi nus pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen ⑦thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan rasasnyigazigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur7gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 63—229

sems dpa' chen po byams pa ①la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs tshad med grangs med pa dper na shing chen po snad pa'i shing ②shun rnams 'byung ba de bzhin du sa chen po 'di shun pa bzhin du brtul ba'i ③byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med cing grangs med pa gang yin pa ④de dag gi tshad kyang rtsis mkhan nam/ rtsis mkhan gyi sna chen po la gtogs pa rnams kyis kyang brjod par mi nus pa lhags pasarnams dang / sring mo'i tshogs dge slong ma des ma la sogs pa dang / ri dgas du'adzin gyi ma sa ga dang /btsun mo phreng ldan ma la sogs te/ dge bsnyen ma du ma dang / khyim bdag bzang sbyin la sogs pa dge bsnyen du ma dag stetsho/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor mang po de dag thams cad kyi gung la bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das chos7kyi sgo ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rang gi mal nas langs te bsams ⑨pa/ bdag ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas de nas de rang gi mal nas langs pa dang rgyal po gshegs so zhes rnga bo che chen po dag ni rdung / dung dag ni 'bud/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang po bsgreng ba dag ni nam mkha' la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du kun du snang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ni mkhyen bzhin du zed pa yin pas de nas de na bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo rnga bo che chen po dag gi sgra dang / dung dag gi sgra grag pa 'di ci zhig /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sa skyong ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dam pa 'dir mchis te⑩/ de'i rnga bo che dag brdungs pa'i sgra chen po 'byin pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir rnga bo che'i sgra 63—230

'byin/ gsol pa①/ rgyal po shākya'i mgon po bltasnyizhing mchi ba des rang gi dpung la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'deng gis〈chos shig ces go bar bgyid pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis kyang chos kyisnyirnga bo che brdungasasnyil chos kyi dung bus shig dang / ngas7de nas rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi mdo bshad do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gisnyirnga bo che chen po zhes bgyi ba'i mdo sngon nam yang ma thos lags na rnga bo che chen po zhes bgyi ⑨ba'i chos de ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ci khyod kyis shes par 'gyur snyama'amanya / re zhig 7phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag thams cad 8kyis kyang 'di ltar rnga bo che chen po'i mdo yig 'bru bzhi tsam yang mi shes na/ khyod kyis lta sngon ma thos pa ji ltar shes/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das chos 'di de ltar rnyed dka' ba ni ngo mtshar che lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo mdo 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ kun dga' bo rnga bo che 8chen po'i mdo chen po 'di ni 'di lta ste dper na/ 'jig rten na me tog u dum bāsnyir rnyed pa bzhin no/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi chos nyid ma lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yang chos nyid yin no/ /gsol pa/ gal te 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi chos nyid lags na ci'i slad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dang de dag tu 63—231

ma bshad cing rab tu ma bstan la/ ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi mchog 'di dag 'dir mchis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dper na 'di na dge slong dgon pa pa 'ga' zhig /ri bo'am/ ①'bab chu'i 'gram 'amanya/ phug cig na 'dug 'dug pa las nam nangasasnyenas grong ngam/ grong khyer zhig tu bsod snyoms kyi phyir song na des sbrul lam/ khyi'am/ mi shi ba'i ro'am/ shi ba'i ro gang yang rung0ba mthong ngo / /des de mthong nas e ma'o kyi hud e ma'o kyi hud bdag kyang yun ring por 'khor bar 'khor ba na/ 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs dag nyams su myong bar0gyur pas da srid pa ni tha chad yin no zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de dus gzhan zhig na snying dga' bar 'gyur ba'i ④chos 'ga' zhig gis yid bde ba dang / de nas yang mi sems pa las yang des ro mthong ste/ de mthong ba na de yid byung nibar gyur nas de phyir zhing grong khyer ram/ ri 'or ra4/lung pa'i mdor rgyu zhing / de de ltar rgyu ba na shi nas zhag gcig lon pa'am/shi nas zhag gnyis lon pa'am zhes bya ba nas/ mi ro mthong na zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ⑩ste/ de mthong ba kho nas 'bras bu'i mchog dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byed pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sdug bsngal gyi gtam yang mi gsung / mi rtag pa'i gtam yang mi gsung / bdag med pa dang / mi gtsang ba'i gtam yang mi gsung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni de dag gi chos nyid yin te/ de na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag gis dgos pa'i don du ni rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 63—232

sems dpa' chen po rnams la 'di skad ces rigs kyi bu dag re zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams kyi don du zhing gi snyigs ma snyigs ma lnga can gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di 'dra bar 'byung ba ni dka'atub mdzad pa yin te/ desalta bas na rigs kyi bu dag khyod kyis kyang de ltar bslab par bya'o zhes rab tu 'jog par mdzad/ 'doms par mdzad do/ /de nas de dag lta 'dod cing phyag byed par 'dod par 'gyur te/ de dag lta 'dod cing phyag byed par 'dod pa na de dag gis de rnams nye bar bstan pas de'i phyir de dag mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'ong bar 'gyur zhing 'ongs nas kha cig ni sa dang po thob par 'gyur/ kha cig gis7ni sa bdun pa dang / brgyad pa dang /dgu pa dang / bcu pa'i bar dag kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo 'di ni shin tu rnyed par rjodaka' ba yin te/ phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i 'khor 'di dag thams cad nyan par 'dod pa yang de'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /thams cad lhags pa legs so lhags pa legs so/ /'di dag thams cad kyis shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i mdo 'di 'dra ba thob par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo thams cad kyi thun mong ltar mdo 'di thun mong ma yin pas lhags pa legs so zhes tshig tu ma brjod0cig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du thams cad lhags pa legs so/ /lhags pa legs so zhes mi bgyi ba dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo mdo 'di ni zab cing rtogs par dka' ba/ yid ches shing dad par dka' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba yin te/ kun dga' bo de'i57phyir 63—233

'ongs pa dang ma 'ongs pa thams cad la lhags pa legs so lhags pa legs sonyezhes tshig tu ma brjodakhucig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yul ko sashela'i rgyal po gsal rgyal g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus su rnga bo che'i sgra 'byin pa dang ske/ khar dkrol debasalgepa de'i tshe dpung gi tshogs thams cad kyi ma lags sam / ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rnga bo che de nyid gang gi tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal pha rol gyi dpung dang lhan cig g.yul 'gyed dupa de'i dus su ji tsam na rnga bo che'i sgra byung ba de'i tshe sems can mang poshedag ni thos nas dga' bar mi⑧'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can snar ma'i rigs can gzhanashedag ni sgra de thos na de nyid kyis de dag 'chi ba'am/ 'chi ba la thug pa'i sdug bsngal skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo 'di ni kun dga' bo khyod kyis kyang mi shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo chos kyi sgo'i mdo 'di la ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can rnams yid ches par mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na rgyu des na gang gi tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus su rgyal po rnga bo che'i sgra 'byin pa ji lta ba de bzhin du rnga bo che chen po'i mdo 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba yin te/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de na bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la bos te/ bos nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'od srung7ci dge slong 'di dag dad pa can tshul dang 'thun pa/ mthu dang ldan pa yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de'i don ci lags/bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung7sems can sbun pa lta bu ma yin pa de dag rnga bo che 63—234

chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo 'di nyan par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du gnas brtan mod gal ①gyi bu chen po yang rang la smod par bgyid cing / bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bdag kyang gal te de 'dra ba'i dge slong dag mchis na de dag gi nang du mchis pa ma lags na de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa lta ci smos te/ dge slong tshul khrims 'chal pa dang / tshul khrims dang mi ldan pa gang lags pa de dag ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di thams cad ni〈tshul khrims bsrung bdu/ tshul dang 'thun pa lags te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na de dag ni tsan dan gyi snying po 'dra ba sha stag lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung 'khor 'di thams cad tshul khrims bsrungasalgepa/ tshul dang 'thun0pa yin yang ci dgongs pa'i tshig la mkhas pa yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dgongs pa'i tshig ces bgyi ba ci lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung dgongs pa'i tshig ces bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs ⑧pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba da 0ltar 'di las de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa/ brtan pa/ zhi ba/ ther zug pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang nyams par mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba ste/ mdo 'di ni dgongs pa'i tshig ces bya'o/ /'od srung mi 'thun pa'i mdo dag pa 'od gsal ba 'di ni sems can dman pa rnams kyis rgyu dang gtan tshigs brgya stong gis rig par bya dgos so/ /'od srung de lta bas na yang khyod kyis re zhig 'khor 'di rtogs shig /de nas de'i tshe gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos sems can lhags pa 'di dag ci 'dra ba zhig yin par bltas so/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la rgya chen po ma yin pa'i sems can rnams dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs 63—235

rgyas kyi theg pa can rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad rang rang la smod par byed de/ dper na gyad kyi tshogs chen por rgyal po'i gyad stong thub pa zhig stan las langs te/'di na kho bo dang lhan cig 'gyed par 'os pa'i rgol phod pa gang yin pa de su yod ces dril bsgrags pa dang / de nas de na rgol bar ma 'os pa'i sems can gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni bdag cag gsod par 'gyur gyisatu'adi dang lhan cig bdag cag 'gyed par mi nus so zhes rang gis rang la smad nas cang mi smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gal te des der gyad kyi zla 'ga' yang ma rnyed na de de na dpa' bo gyad zla med du gyur cing ru mtshon 'dzugs pa de bzhin du de na rgyalasnyipo ma yin pa'i sems can nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can rnams dang / theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa rnams kyang bdag cag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das bzhin du yang nga ni rtag pa brtan pa zhi ba ther zug pa yin no zhes ston pa 'di ni rtogs par mi nus so zhes 'dor b.rashebyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni yun ring por stonasapa nyid kyi lta ba nyams par byed pa'i lta ba bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir te/ dman pa'i sems can rnams kyis mdo dag pa 'di thos nas dong ngo / /phyogs bcu de dang de dag nas lhags pa'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can dang / byang chub sems dpa'i byatheg pa la gsar du zhugs pa gang dang gang dag yin pa de dang de dag dang lhan cig tu gang dang gang dag lhags pa de dag las kyang bcu'i cha'i cha dang ske/ brgya'i cha'i cha dang / stong gi cha'i cha dang / brgya stong gi cha'i cha dang /63—236

bye ba'i cha'i cha dang / grangs med pa'i cha'i cha gang yin pa dag 'dus par gyur to / /de la tsan dan gyi snying po 'dra ba dhispun pa lta bu ma yin pa'i dge bsnyen ci 'dra ba dag 'dug par gyur ce na/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dang ldan pa dang /bslab pa'i gzhi7brgyad dang ldan pa dang / gsum 'don pa dang / bcu bzhi'i dang / bcwa〈lnga'i zhes bya ba nas zla ba byed kyi dang / tshes brgyad kyi dang ske/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba phyed kyi bar gyi yan lag brgyad legs par blangs pa sbyin pa dngakyi/ snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod 57pa dang / don 'thun pa can gal te mu ge lo bcu'am/ bcu gnyis sam/ gzhan yang lo mang po byung yang bdag gis bza' ba'am/ bldag pa'am/ zas sam/ btung ba rang gi skal ba de las bdag gis pha dang ma gnyis la phyed phyed/ dge slong rnams la phyed 'bul zhing bdag gis dge slong46)rnams la mchod yon gyi sbyin pa dor bar mi bya'o snyam pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus ngan pa la rtag par skal ba gang yin pa de jikhutsam zhig yod par 'gyur zhe na/ skyes bu dpa' bo de'i zla ba phyed kyis za ma gcig cig 'byung ste/ des za ma gcig po yang dge slong rnams la byin nas bsod nams mi zad pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /skyes bus nide ltar byin nas 'jig rten du/ /skyes bu dam par 'gyur bas legs 'dod mis/ /'di na bdag nyid bag med ci bya ste/ /de bas bstan la bag byed mchog yin no / /nor ni dgra dang chom0)rkun sogs mang dang / /rgyal po chu dang me bodang mdza' bshes dang / /nye du mi mdza' bgo skal spyod mang gis/ /sdig pa spyad hu1pa yis ni zad par 'gyur/ /rang dang rang gi longs spyod dag la yang / spyod par7byed pa skyes bu rnams kyi nor/ /spyad hunyepa nyid dang gnod pa gzhan 63wa 237

gyis kyang / /zad par mi 'gyur shes bya dam chos phyir/ /'di0zad byas mchog pha rol zad mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'dir 'phel 'jig rten pha rol du/ /zad par mi 'gyur kha dog mthur bcas byed/ /mthong na thams cad dga' zhing rnyed pa dang / /mdog dang grags pa rab tu gsal bar 'gyur/ / de yi7phyugs rnams zad par mi 'gyur zhing / /de yi bran pho bran mo las byed dang / /las kyi mtha' rnams nyams par mi 'gyur te/ /de la thabashemo rtsod dang 'gyedakyimed cing / /de ni nam yang gnod sems med mchog thob/ /sbyin la dga' ba'i skye bosnyi'ajig rten du/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan 'thob 'gyur bas/ /de lta bas na rtag tu chos 'dod pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig phrad par 'gyur/ /lus dang srog la mi blta lhug par gtong / /mi yi mi mchog de ni lag rkyong yin/ /sems can kun la rjes su snying brtse bas/ /bu bzhin mthong na sdug cing rig par ldan/ /bsam gtan bag yod thosalgepas dpag tu med/ /khyim na gnas pa'i shes rab can gyis ni/ /rtag tu de ltar bya dgos de dag gi/ /dpe ni de 'dra mang du yod pa yin⑧/ /yang de'i tshe na dge bsnyen ma ci 'dra ba dag cig 'dug ce na/ ji tsam khwa ma langs pa de tsam nas rang gis phyags ma blangs te/ rang gi nyen kor 'phyag cing ba'i lci ba'i7byug pas sa gzhi byugs pas / sa rgyan gyis mdzes par byed pa'i legs par bya ba byed pa yin/ des der bsod snyoms pa rab tu mang po 'ongs par shes na rang gi lag gis bza' ba dang ske/ btung ba gya nom pa legs par rgyun tu stobs 7par byed cing de dag dang bdag grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ grong dag tu yang phrad cing 'grogs par gyur cig /bdag nam yang yul mtha' 'khob tu skye ba dang /63—238

dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skol bar dus ston bzhi byed par ma gyur cig /bdag sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims spyad pa dang / nyanatupa dang / bdag chos kyisnyegatam la rtag tu spyod par gyur cig ces de lta bu'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i sring mo dge bsnyen ma yid rnam par dag pa ste/ de lta bu nisridage bsnyen ma'i yon tan dag yin no/ /de la dge slong dang dge slong ma ci 'dra ba dag cig ce na/ dul ba/ zhi ba/ bag tsha ba med pa/ zag pa zad pa/ tha ma'i lus 'dzin pa/ tsan dan gyi snying po 'dra ba'i 'khor dag go/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ci 'dra ba dag cig ce na/ thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dod pa/ thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo sde 'dzin pa6)/ thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po tshuphan pa ston pa/ thams cad kyang sangs rgyas rtag pa nyid 'dod pa/thams cad kyang dgongs pa'i tshig la byang ba/ thams cad kyang nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde ston pa/ sran thub pa/ thams cad kyang tshul khrims 'chal pa rnams tshar gcod cing phan 'dogs par zhugs pa des bsnyernams la mchog tu gus pa/theg pa chen po la dad pa chen po thob pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yalgematshan du mi 'dzin pabya/ 'di lta bu'i mdo sde rgya chen po mchog bor nas mdo sde gzhan mi sgrogasarwatepa'i shes rab can/ gang du sangs rgyas rtag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod do zhes bstanatshwanyepa gzhan yang sgrogs shing mi spong ba/ brtan pa/ 'jig tshogs la lta bas stong pa stong pasnyim yin gyi/'dus byas thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ ther zug mchog gi gzhi de 'dod pa de lta bu la sogs pa'i yon tan la brten pa dag ste/ yon tan lhag ma 63—239

ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'od srung de lta bas na khyod kyis lan gnyis lan gsum du yang 'khor sol cig /de nas gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du yang bltas shing brtags te bsal na sbun pa lta bu'i skyes bu lhag ma'i 'khor dag yod par 'gyur phro/ /yang lan gsum gyi bar du bsal bas bsal〈mib na skyes bu spun pa lta bu ma yin pasasha stag tu gyur to④/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la bka' stsal pa / 'od srung da 'khor 'di dag dag pa snying por gyur pa yin mod/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung 'khor 'di gelegs par sbyangs pa legs so legs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar 'khor yongs su sbyangs pa lags/ ston ku'i zla ba nya ba la rnam par dag pa bzhin no/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rtsis mkhan nam/ rtsis mkhan gyi slob mas/sngon gyi sdom pas bsdams pa la 6)'god pa'i chas phrin ⑦lhag ma gang yin pa de 'dug pa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'khor lhags pa gang yin pa 'di dag thams cad ces bya ba nas grangs med pa khyadapag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i ⑨bar snga ma bzhin no / /'od srung de dag las bye ba brgya stong gi cha'i cha gang dag yin pa ni mi mchog bag tsha ba med pa'i 'khor 'dug pa 'di dag ⑩ yin gyis tunye'od srung da yang khyod kyis 'khor rnams la grogs po dag ci khyed7cag rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo chen po yangs pa theg pa gcig pa 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po dad par dka' ba/ yid ches par dka' ba 'di mnyan par nus sam zhes dris shigatso /'od srung de bzhin du khyod kyis lan gnyis lan gsum du yang 'khor rnams la dris shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/ de nas gnas brtan 63—240

'od srung chen po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tunyegazar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ②te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshalashenas langs te lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas 'khor mang po de la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo nyan pa'i 'os yin nam / de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa chen posregacig pa 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa de khyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos lan gnyis lan gsum du yang skul ba bskul ba ⑤dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/btsun pa 'od srung bdag cag dam pa'i chos mnyan pa'i ched du mchis lags pas nyan par 'tshal gyis⑥/ btsun pa 'od srung de bzhin gshegs pas bdag cag la thugs brtse bas ninye bar bzung ste/ mdo chen po de 0legs par bsgrags pa mdzad du gsol/ 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ ji ltar yid ches par 'gyur/ de dag gis 7smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung dper na skyes bu btsas nas lo nyi shu lon pa zhig la bu lo brgya lon pa dag yod do zhes smras pa la gal te de bzhin gshegs pa de kho na bzhin du gsung na/ bdag cag gis kyang de bzhin du yid ches par bgyi lags na btsun pa 'od srung dam pa'i chos mnyan pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni ci gsung ba de bzhin du mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni kun nas spyan mnga' ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa yin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung gzhan yang bdag cag ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen to/ /smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag ni rnga bo che chen po'i mdo chen po mnyan pa 63—241

dang / bklag pa dang / gzung ba dang / bstan pa'i 'os yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung 'di ni ji ltar skyes bu btsas nas lo nyi shu lon pa'i bu lo brgya lon pa dag ltar rnga bo che chen po'i mdo 'di yang de dang7'dra'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das bzhin du da dung dukhuganas so zhes bya ba dang / bdag yod pa ma yin zhing bdag gi yod pa ma yin pa dag la yang bdag ces bya bas so/ /de dag gis gsol pa/ de ni bcom ldan 'das kho nas mkhyen pas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skadashegasungs pa de bzhin du gzung bar bgyi lags so/ /'od srung gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas da ni rnga bo che chen po'i mdo chen po bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnga bo che brdung du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi dung budakyidu gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung legs so legs so/ /'od srung da ni khyod rnga bo che chen po'i mdo༅chen po 'di nyon cig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis mnyan par bgyi lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gi spyod yul du ma gyur kyang de bzhin gshegs pas bdag rnga bo che chen po'i slad du bdag la gus par mdzad lags pas so/ /yang gsol pa/ji ltar lags zhe srin bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la 'di skad ces 'od srung khyod nga dang lhan cig 'dug gis latshur shog ces gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni don de'i slad du bgyis pa gzo bar bgyis pa tshor bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung legs so legs so/ /ngas kyang don 'di'i phyir gsungs so/ /'od srung dper na rgyal po gsal rgyal 63—242

gyis glang po che dang / rta dang / dmag mi rnams kha zas dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / bldag pa la sogs pas gsor 'jug go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gi tshe bdag rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga dang / dung gi sgra shin tu chen po 'byin pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba danatudag bsgrengakhub dang / gang gi tshe pha rol gyi dpung gi tshogs chen po nye bar gnas par gyur pa de'i tshe/ bdag gis gsor bcugashepa'i phan yon rjes su dran nas pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang lhan cig g.yul 'gyedakyipar 'gyur zhing de'i tshe sems can rnams la yang phan pa byed par 'gyur/ bdag gi bka' la yang phan pa byed par 'gyur ro snyam ste④/ de dag kyang de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /'od srung de bzhin du nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das na yang khyod kyis rnga bo che chen po'i mdo 'di 'byin par 'gyur ro zhes ngas khyod la stan gyi phyed bstabs ⑧pa yin gyis7nges pa kho nar de bzhin du gyis shig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni khyod kyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras kyi thu bor gzhag pa'i rigs lags so/ / bka' stsal pas 'od srung dper na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rang gi bu rnams la 8'di dag ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bdag gi rigs 'tshob par 8'gyur ro zhes bstan bcosasnyisna tshogs dang / bzo'i yiganas rnams la sbyong bar byed pa de bzhin du 'od srung khyod kyang nga 'das nas mdo 'di 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /'od srung dper na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rgyal po mang pos bsngos nas de rnams dang lhan cig5)g.yul 'gyed pa de dang de'i dus kyi dmag mi glang po che ba dang / rta pa dang / dpung bu chung gang dag yin pa las go cha bzang po bgos shing rnga bo che chen po dang / dung gi sgra thos na mi 63—243

dngang mi skrag cing bred par mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag la ni rgyal pos bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / zas dang / skom dang / gos dang /rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / chas dag sbyin par byed do/ /de las gzhan pa g.yul ngor zhugs nas g.yul 'gyed pa'i dmag mi gang yin pa de dag la ni gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig la sogs pa ཿ/ / grong rdal dang /yul rnams sbyin par byed do/ /de na skyes bu dpa' bo sde dang bcas par phyir mi ldog pa/ glang po che ba dang / rta pa dang / shing rta pa dang ldan pas dgra'i dpung pham par byed pa gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal po rang gis rig par byas nas rgyal tshabashetu dbang bskur ba'i cod pan bcing bar byed do/ /'od srung de bzhin du nga'i nyan thos dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang ske/ dge bsnyen ma la〈khubaslab pa legs par ji ltar bcas pa la legs par bslabasal pa gang yin pa de dag dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa dang ske/ 'dul ba'i cho ga dang / spyod yul la gnas pa de dag la ni de bzhin gshegs pas lha dang mi'i bde ba sbyin par mdzad do/ /de las gzhan pas ④phung po'i bdud dngasal/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang ske/ lha'i bu'i bdud pham par byed pa gang yin pa de dag la ni de bzhin gshegs pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam par grol ba'i cod pan 'ching bar mdzad do/ /de las gzhan pa'i rgya chen po la lhag par mos pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i che ba'i bdag nyid rtag pa dang / brtan pa dang / zhi ba dang / ther zug pa 'dod pa'i sems can gang yin pa de dag la ni de bzhin gshegs pas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye 63—244

shes theg pa chen po dbang bskur ba'i cod pan 'ching bar mdzad do/ /'od srung de bzhin du khyod kyang de ring theg pa chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i cod pan bcings te/ sangs rgyas brgya stong phrag mang po'i spyan snga nas rnga bo che chen po'i mdo 'di 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na 'od srung khyod kyis kyang da ni nga 'das nas mdo 'di 'byung7ba'i rigs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das re zhig bdag gis rig⑧par ltasarngo mi thogasakhukyang bcom ldan 'das re zhig de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das sam bzhugs kyang bdag gis phyung nas bstan par bgyi lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung legs so/ /da ni de bzhin gshegs pas rnga bo che chen po zhes bya ba'i mdo chen po bshad pa brtsam mol/ /de nas nam mkha' las lha'i tshogs dang / 'brug gi tshogs kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'od srung legs so legs so/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir da ni lha rnams dang / 'brug gi tshogs rnams kyang me tog gi char 'bebs shing bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i phye ma'i char gyi rgyun chen po yang 'bebs so/ /'od srung khyod bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang thugs las skyes pa ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras kyi thu bor 'os so/ /de nas lha'i tshogs dang ske/ 'brug gi tshogs kyis skad 'thun par tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /mnyan yod grong khyer dag tu rnga chen dang / /shin tu rnga chen dung rnams sgrogasalgepa na/ /mgon po chos kyi rje yis rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal du chos kyi rnga chen sgrogs7par mdzad/ /'od srung khyod kyis chos rnga brdung bar gyis/ /chos kyi rgyal po dag gis gsungs pa'i mdo/ /zhu ba'i dbyig gus chos rnga che brdungs na/ /lha'i lhas chos mang the tsom7)gcod par mdzad/ /rnga bo che chen po'i mdo chen po 63—245

las 'od srung 'ongs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'od srung ngas sngar mdo 'dishelas gong nas gong du dge slong yangs pa la dad pa'i yid can zhes bya ba zhig yod ces bshad pa dge slong de'i ming / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ sems can gang dag gis thos pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams dbyungakhubar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'tsho byed kyi bu sman mchog ces bya ba yod de/ de gang gi tshe rgyal po gsal rgyal pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang lhan cig g.yul 'gyed par 'gyur la de nas rgyal pos g.yul shom ①pa na sman pa sman mchog bkug ste/bkug nas 'di skad ces/ kye sman pa sman gang gis sems can gang dang gang dag zug rngus ⑤thug par gyur pa'i sems can de dang 0de dag ji lta ⑦ji ltar zug rngu dbyung ⑧bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sman da 0sbyor la 7myur du khyer te shog shig /de nas sman pa sman mchog des sman gyi rgyal po dug sman rtol pa zhes bya ba khyer nas rgyal po chen po g.yul〈nyengor 'jug pa'i rnga bo che la sman des byugs〈nyeshing bdugs te brdungs so/ /byugs shing bdugs 8te brdungs ma thag tu sems can zug rngus zug par gyur pa gang dag yin pa de dag gis sgra de dpag tshad dam/ dpag tshad gnyis su thos nas thos pa tsam gyis sems can de dang de dag thams cad kyi zug rngu rnams dbyungachabar 'gyur/ zug rngu rnams bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /'od srung de bzhin du dge slong yangs pa la dad pa'i yid can 63—246

de'i ming thos pa'i sems can gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams dbyungatubar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des nga'i⑧bstan pa la mdo 'di phyung zhing rgyas par byas te/ de bas na chos dang ldan pa mngon sum du byas pa de'i mthu'o/ /'od srung ltos/ re zhig rgyal po'i rnga bo che sems med pa phal pa de yang sems dang bcas pas sman gyis byugs shing bdugs te brdungs ma thag tu sems can rnams la phan pa skyed par byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yangs pa la dad pa'i yid can gyi ming thos pas sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum 'bral bar 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gal te de ltar re zhig byang chub sems dpa'i ming thos pas sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams 'bral bar 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan brjod pa'am/ yon tan yongs su bsgrags pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/gal te de ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan tsam gyis sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams 'bral bar 'gyur na sems can la phan pa ston pa zhig gis rnga bo che chen po'i mdo 'di las 'gres sam/ tshigs su bcad pa'am/ tshig 'ga' tsama'amanya/ming tsam bstan pa'am/ le'u ston na sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams 'bral bar 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngas dge slong dgashetshul khrims dang ldan pa'i sems kyisasmon lam 'grub bo zhes bshad de/ sngon smon lam legs par sbyang ba 63—247

byas pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi chos nyid yin te/ 'di lta ste/ rnga bo che chen po'i mdo chen pos ma byas pa ma byung ba/ ma 'gags pa'o/ /'od srung khyod kyang de lta bas na ma 'ongs pa'i dus na nga dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyod kyi yang ming thos pa'i dge slong ngam/ /dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang yin pa de dag dang / sems can de dag thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu rnams 'bral bar 'gyur ro / /de'i phyir 'od srung khyod kyang mdo 'di zhus nas yun ring poratu'ajig rten du 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de lta lags na rnga bo che chen po'i mdo chen po de las phyogs 'ga' tsam zhig bdag la legs par bshad du gsol / /'od srung dus la bab kyisashekhyod nga la phyogs 'ga' zhig zhus shig /'od srung gis legs so zhes gsol nas zhu ba 'di zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das/gang na srid yod srid pa der sdug bsngal/ /gang na srid med sdug bsngal med pa yi / /mya ngan 'das pa de ni mchog tu bde/ /bde sdug spang phyir mya ngan 'das mchog 'gyur/ /srid pa yod na bde dang sdug bsngal te/ /srid pa med na bde dang sdug bsngal med/ /de'i7phyir mya ngan 'das thob 'dod pa yis/ /rigs kyi bu yis srid 'dod yongs su gcad/ /ces bka' stsal pa 'di'i don ci lags / 'dir tshigs su bcad pas legs par bka' stsal pa/ sred pa thams cad mi rtag mi brtan la/ /thams cad du yang snying po med pas na/ /srid pa gang yin de ni sdug bsngal te/ /gang la srid med de na sdug bsngal med/ /srid pa yod pa min na sdug bsngal med/ /'di na srid yod sdug bsngal 'gyur 63—248

bas na/ /srid la mngon par dga' bar mi bya zhing / /srid pa rnams la yid brtan 'gro mi bya/ /bcom ldan srid dang srid pa med pa dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal 'gyur ba yod par ston/ /de skad cesatugasungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la 'di skad cesashebaka' stsal to/ /'od srung de ltar tshig gi don 'di ni brtan pa'i tshig gi don yin pas re zhig 'od srung khyod kyis mi shes so/ /sems can ni phal cher srid pa gcod par mi byed de/ sems can rnams ni 'du byed skud pas brgyus/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu bde/ /'od srung gis gsol pa/ gang gis mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa de mi gnas/ /de la bde ba ming tsam ste/ /mis ni myong bar 'gyur ma mchis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thar pasabartan pa ming tsam minaX/ /yod dang med dang ther zug gzhi/ /de lta bas na 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul ma yin zhing spyod yul ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gzugs kyang lags la ther zug kyang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung dper na lho phyogs kyi yul skye bo'i bcom brlag ces bya ba nas sems can gzhan 'ga' zhig 'ongs par gyur la/ mi de la mi 'ga' zhig gis khyod gang nas 'dir 'ongs zhes dris pa dang / de nas des smras pa/ kho bo ni lho phyogs kyi bcom brlag nas 'ongs so/ /mis yang smras pa/ de yul gyi phyogs gang na yod/ de nas mi des mdzub mos lho phyogs kyi lam gyi nam mkha' bstan na/ 'od srung mi des mi de la ji ga yid ches par 'gyur ram/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ song na de mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'od srung de bzhin du khyod kyis ma mthong bar dad 63—249

pas yid ches par gyis shig/ //'phags pa rnga bo che chen po'i le'u bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'dinyebaka' stsal to/ /ji ltar mkha' la mdzubashemos ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin thar pa ming tsam gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar lho phyogs bcom brlag mi bzhin du/ /de bzhin nga nyid brten⑧pa med nas byon/ /'od srung 'di la'ang don mthong na/ /rgyu ni dgos pa yod med de/ /mngon sum ma gyurasnyidon la ni/ /rgyu dang rkyen kyang de bzhin no/ /'od srung de lta bas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu du mas thar pa'i tshig gi don nye bar ston par mdzad do/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung rgyu zhes bya ba ci yin par 'dod/gsol pa/ rgyu ni byed rgyu zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rkyen ces bya ba gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das rkyen ces bgyi ba de ni rten lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/'od srung rigs pa'i dpe dang / rgyu dang nye bar sbyar ba dang/ byed rgyu rnams kyis de ji lta bu yin pa de kho na de bzhin du gsal bar ston cig /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das dper na pha dang ma gnyis 'dus pa las bu 'byung bar 'gyur te / de la ma ni rgyu lags so/ /pha ni rkyen lags te/ de lta bas na pha dang ma gnyis ni bu'i rgyu dang rkyenashelags so/ /de bzhin du rgyu dang rkyen gyis chos skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni grub pa zhes bgyi'o/ /grub pa zhes bya ba ci yin/grub pa zhes bgyi ba ni 'jig rten gyi grags pa lags so/ /'jig rten zhes bya ba ci yin/ 'od srung gis gsol pa/ sems can dang ldan pas btags pa gang lags pa'o/ /sems can zhes bya ba ci yin/ sems can zhes bgyi ba ni chos 63—250

kyi brdar btags pa lags so/ /chos zhes bya ba ci yin/ gsol pa/ chos ma lags pa'i chos dang / chos kyi chos so/ /chos de dag kyang rnam pa gnyis su bstan to/ /rnam pa gnyis gang lags zhe7na/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / gzugs can dang /② gzugs can ma lags pa ste/ de las mu gsum pa ni ma mchis pa lags so/ /de la chos zhes bya ba ji lta bu yin/gsol pa/ chos zhes bgyi ba ni gzugs ma mchis pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ chos ma yin pa ji lta bu yin/ chos ma lags pa7zhes bgyi ba de yang gzugs ma mchis pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te chos dang chos ma yin pa gzugs med cing mtshan ma med pa yin na de la chos ni gang / chos ma yin pa ni gang / gsol pa/ chos zhes bgyi ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /chos ma lags pa zhes bgyi ba ni sredakyipa zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te de ltar chos dang chos ma yin pa gzugs med cing mtshan nyid med pa yin na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ji ltar ci zhig mtshan ma gang gis 'di ni chos yin no zhes rnam par mkhyen par 'gyur/ gsol pa/sems can rnams 'khor bar skyes nas dge ba'i bsod nams dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs la bsten pa na de'i tshul 'di dang / de de ltar chos mngon du yang dag par spyad pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid thams cad kun du skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar chos mngon du yang dag par spyod pa gang lags pa de lta bu'i sems can de dag ni chos lags so/ /sems can rnams 'khor bar skyes nas bsod nams ma lags pa/ sdig pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs kun du spyod cing chos ma lags pa kun⑧spyod pa/ de kho na la sdig pa mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid 63—251

de dag thams cad skye bar 'gyur te/ de ltar chos ma lags pa kun du spyod pa gang lags pa7de lta bu'i sems can de ni chos ma lags pa lags so/ /de la sems can zhes bgyi ba ni nang gi sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams te②/ khams bzhis yang dag par bsdus shing btags pa dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang ske/ yid kyi skye mched drug dang / dbang po lnga dang / tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / sems pa dang / sems dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/de ltar srid pa'i yan lag bcu gsum gyi bar ni chos thams cad ces bgyi ba ③lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung de dag kho na la sems can gyi chos zhes bya na/ de la sems can zhes bya ba'i chos gang yin zhe nadu/ gsol pa/de la sems can zhes bgyi bar btags ⑥pa'i chos 'ga' yang ma mchis lags sol/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dper na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi rnga bo che zhes bgyi ba gang lags pa de'i rnga bo che zhes bgyi ba de ⑦gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung rnga bo che gang yin pa7de nyid rnga bo che yin par shes par bya ste/ rnga bo che zhes bya ba ni pagasalgepa dang / dbyig7gu dang ske/ shing leb dang / chos 'di gsum tshogs pa gang yin pa'i〈nyechos de dag la rnga bo che zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ de la brdung7ba'i mi la rnga bo che zhes bgyi ba lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ mi med par yang rnga bo che rlung gis bskyod pa na sgra 'byung ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnga bo che zhes bgyi ba chos sam/ 'on te chos ma lags pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rnga bo che zhes bya ba 'di ni chos kyang ma yin/ chos ma yin pa yang ma yin no/ /gsol 63—252

pa/ de ci zhes bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ chos gang zhig chos gang dang yang lhan cig ldan pa ma yin zhing / chos ma yin pa dang yang ma yin pa 'dinyelung du ma bstan pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ gal te lung du ma bstan pa'i chos shig mchis na des na 'jig rten na chos gsum mchis par 'gyur ro/ /bka' stsal pa/ lung du ma bstan pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni ji ltar skyes pa yang ma yin/ bud med kyang ma yin pa ltar ma ning zhes bya'o/ /dper na ji lta bu lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung khyod kyis 'di ni pha dang ma 'dus pa'i bu yin no zhes smras pa/ gal te pha dang ma 'bras bu med par gyur na kha cig 'di skad ces/ ma dang pha ni rgyu dang rkyen ma yin no zhes smra bar〈mi'agyur ro/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ sems canashes bon gyi dngos po med pa gang yin pa de dag ni 'bras bu med pas/ de dag ni rtag tu ma ning zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'od srung dper na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang gi tshe pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang lhan cig lhag par nyam nga b.rasho'ugyur pa na brgya la tsheji zhig ltar gyur pa de'i tshe/ de'i drung du dbang thang gis 'tsho ba dag de dang lhan cig rjes su mi 'brang zhing sgrol bar mi byed pa gang yin pa de dag bud med dang 'dra bar blta bar bya'o/ /gsol pa/ ci'i slad du/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po rnams ni zho shas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyi rang bzhin brtags nas gsor 'jug go/ /rgyu des na sa bon med pa'i sems can de dag pha dang mar mi 'gyur bas sems can de dag ④rtag par ma ning yin par blta bar bya'o/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ dge ba'i chos dang / mi dge ba'i chos dang / lung du ma bstan pa'i chos te⑦/ dge ba'i chos ni tshor ba bde ba yin no/ /mi dge ba'i chos ni 63—253

tshor ba sdug bsngal ba yin no/ /lung du ma bstan pa'i chos ni tshor ba bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa yin te sems can rnams ni chos 'di gsum gyis rtag tu reg par 'gyur ro/ /de la tshor ba bde ba zhes bya ba ni lha dang mi rnams kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yin no/ /tshor ba sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba patudang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa dang / yi dgas kyi 'jig rten gyi yin no/ /tshor ba bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa ni ji ltar 'brum bu phra mo dang / shu ba yin te de la 'brum bu phra mo dang / shu bas nyon mongs pa'i sems can rnams ni lung du ma bstan pa yin nam / 'od srung gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ci'i phyir/ gsol pa/ bde ba las sdug bsngal 'byung zhing sdug bsngal las kyang sdug bsngal 'byung bas 'di gnyis ka lung du ma bstan pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ci kha zas las nad 'byungakhungam/ gsol pa/gang gi tshe 'tshal ba de'i tshe bde ba zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /gang gi tshe nad du gyur pa de'i tshe sdug bsngal zhes bgyi ba lags teni/ de la shu ba gang lags pa de ni lung du ma bstan pa zhes bgyi lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te de lta bas na bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba yang lung du ma bstan pa zhes bya la pha dang ma dang bu yang lung du ma bstan par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'o na ji lta bu yin/ gsol pa/ ji ltar 'du shes med 'du shes med min la sogs pa'i lha ther zug gi gzhi zhes mi bgyi ba lta bu'i chos dge ba 'di yang de dang 'dra lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung khyod kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes la sems can no zhes smras pa/ des na 'du shes med 63—254

'du shes med min la sogs pa'i lha dag sems can ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams la yang 'du byed kyi ngo botumachis lags so / /bka' stsal pa/ 'o na tshor ba dang 'du shes ma gtogs pa'i chos 'di dag la sems can zhe'am/ 'on te kha cig de lta bu'i sems can dag yod do zhes zer na/ des na 'di ltar sems can ma yin pa'i chos dang ldan pa dag sems can du 'gyur ro/ /ci'i slad du/ sems can gzugs can yin nam 'on te gzugs can ma yin/ gsol pa/ gzugs can yang ma lags/gzugs can ma lags pa yang ma lags mod kyi chos de dag dang ldan pa ni sems can zhes bgyi lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te de ltar na7sems can ma yin pa'i chos dang ldan pa de dag sems can du skye bar 'gyur ba'i dugazugs med pa zhes bya'o/ /ji0ste de ltar gyur na 'jig rten du chos rnam pa gnyis po gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa de 'byung bar 'gyur te/ chos gzugs can dang / chos ma yin pa gzugs can no/ /thar pa chos dang lhan cig gam/ 'on te chos ma lags pa dang lhan cig lags/ gzugs ma mchis pa'i lha la yang thar pa mchis pa lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ de ni ma yin te / chos 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas pa yod pas/ de'i phyir gzugs med pa'i lha de dag kyang 'dus byas kyi nang du bgrang bar 'gyur gyi thar pa ni 'dus ma byas yin no/ /gsol pa/ des na gzugs ma mchis pa'i lha rnams kyang gzugs dang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /'od srung ji ltar 'dus byas thams cad gzugs can yin pa dang / 'dus7ma byas gzugs can ma yin par smos shigashegasal bar sgros shig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs 63—255

ma mchis pa'i lha rnams gzugs dang ldan no zhes bgyi ba'i gzugs sangs rgyas kyi yul du 'gyur ba lags granganye/ bdag cag gi yul du ni mi 'gyur lags so//bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung legs so legs so/ /de bzhin du thar par gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang nga'i ②yul yin te/ de rnams kyang gzugs can yin la thar pa de yang gzugs can yin no/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung ci khyod kyis gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyi lha'i gnas dang byed pa yang dag par shes sam/ yang bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung ci khyod kyis gzugs can gyi lha rnams gzugs med pa zhes bya ba'i nang du bgrang ngam/ ci na bdag cag gi yul ma lags so zhes zer/ yang bka' stsal pa/ thar pa brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas blo shin tu rnam par dag pa rnams kyang de kho na bzhin du gzugs zhes bya bar gsal bar yang dag par ltos shig /'od srung gis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar na thar pa thob pa gnas pa'i7phyir yang bde ba dang / sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/sems can nad pa zhig sman bcud kyis len 'thungs nas nad dang bral bar gyur na ci yang nad bu can du 'gyur ram/ gal te 'ga' zhig mchis na nges par 'gyur lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te las med kyang 'gyur ram/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung bde ba dang sdug bsngal spangs pa de nyid thar pa yin te/ nad ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal lta bu yin la7mi lta bur ni mya ngan las 'das pa thob par blta'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal spangs pa zhes bgyi ba las ma mchis pas nad zad pa thob pa lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/63—256

thar pa thob pa ni 'jig rten gyi bde ba dang7sdug bsngal gyi las gang yin pa de dang bral zhing ②zad pa bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i ②slad du yang 'gum par mi 'gyur lags/ bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' nam mkha'7lta bu'o zhes bya ba rgya mtsho chen po nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes pa/ ci nam mkha' dpe med pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu yin nam/ de bzhin du thar pa ni dpe med pa yin no/ /ji ltar gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyisnyigazugs yod kyang dga' ba de dang de lta bus gnas pa mi shes pa de bzhin du nyan thos dang rang ponasangs rgyas rnams kyi thar pa yang btags pa med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' yang mi rtag pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dper na ji lta bu ji ltar rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi khang bzangasarkyungang pa ltar dkar ba brtsigs pa de'i tshe nam mkha' nyams pa de ni nam mkha' zhig pa zhes bgyi'o/ /gsolasnyipa/ chos gzugs med pa ji ltar 'jig /gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyang rji7ltar 'jig lags/bka' stsal pa/ gzugs med pa'i lha gang dag yin pa de dag sems can zhes bgyi bar bgrang ngam ci/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' sems ma mchis pa sems dang bcas pa ji ltar 'gyur lags/ bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' la rten pa'i khang pa'am/ ri gang dang gang dag yin pa zhig kyang nam mkha' mi 'jig pa ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings kyi 'gro ba thams cad la khyab parwa1yang de dang 'dra'o/ /rten nam mkha' 6)mi 'jig pa ltar byed pa po dang /tshor ba po yang de dang 'dra lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus na/ sems can rnams kyi las dang / nyon mongs pa'i chos yod pa gang yin pa 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can 63—257

thams cad dang / chos thams cad ma mchis pa ji lta bu lags/ rnga bo che'i tshogs pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /yang gsol pa/ ji ltar gdugs kyi 'od dang /nor bu'i 'od gnyis po de las 'jig rten na zhugs zhes bgyi ba de bzhin du mi rnams las bdag gir bya ba zhes bgyi na bcom ldan 'das chos gcig po 'di gang gi rnam par smin pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung khyod kyis mi shes sam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ zla ba byung ba smros shig /bcom ldan 'das zla ba ni sems can rnams kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i chos ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gal te de lta na dpe brjod dgos te/ ci ste nor bu dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / me sems can gyis ma byas kyi/ tshogs pas byas pa yin na/ steng gi lha rnams kyis phyag bya ba'i nyi ma dang / zla ba de dag ci sems can ma yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sems can zhes bgyi bas de dag kyang sems can gyi grangs su bgrang ba lags so//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni sems can ma yin no/ /de ci'i slad du lags/ sems can grongashepa'i bshes gnyen⑧can phal pasam yin pa yang sems can rnams dang mnyam par mi rtsi bas/ sangs rgyas ni rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i chos kyi rgyu 'thun pa ste/ sangs rgyas ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin 'kho/ sems can yang rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i chos kyi rgyu 'thun pa yin no/ /'od srung gang gi tshe sems can thams cad zad par gyur pa de'i tshe/ gal te me byung nas 'jig pa'am/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba de smros shig /bcom ldan 'das ma 'tshal lags so/ /ngas sngar khyod kyis mi shes so 63—258

zhes gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba gang nas mchis/ gang du mchinyelags/ bka' stsal pa/ rnga bo che'i sgra gang nas 'ongs/ gang du 'gro/ bcom ldan 'das tshogs pa las lags so//bka' stsal pa/ ji lta bu yin/ ji ltar chos thams cad ma bgyis pa/ byed pa po ma mchis pa/ byed pa po dang bral ba ltar rnga bo che'i sgra yang de dang 'dra lags so/ /bka'7stsal pa/ de ni ma yin te/ rnga bo che la ni byed pa posnyeyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchis lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du mya ngan las 'das pa ther zug gi gzhi thob pa'i sems can de dag su zhig byed de byed pa po med do/ /sems can rnams rang gi bdag nyid kyis bdag byed de/ ji lta zhe na/ sems can gyis gal te bsod nams byed na ni sangs rgyas yin la/ 'on te mi byed na ni sems can yin no/ /sems can thog ma sus bgyis lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi lha la sogs pa gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyang sus byas/ gson por yang ji ltar gnas/ bcom ldan 'das las kyis ni gnas lags na de dag gi las dang de bzhin du khyim bdag tshong dpon dang tshul ④yang 'tshal bar ni rngo mi thogasasnyilags so/ /shin tu gnas pa nyid du su zhig byed/ gsol pa/ las kyis bgyid do/ /las las ni chos du ma skye stenya/ dge ba las kyang chos du ma skye'o⑧/ /de la dge ba las skye ba'i chos ni gang dag lags/ mi dge bas skye ba ni gang dag lags/ bka' stsal pa/ las las ni srid pa skye'o/ /dge ba'i las las ni thar pa skye'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma skyes pa'i gnas dge ba la ji ltar skye bar 'gyur lags/ bka' stsal pa/ gzhan ma yin pa de 63—259

bzhin nyid las7so/ /gal te sangs rgyas dge ba las skye ba lags na/ mi skye ba'i gnas ji ltar 'thob lags/ bka' stsal pa/ legs par spyad pa'i⑧las kyis so/ /de sus bslabasashelags/ bka' stsal pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslabs sokha/ /thog ma mkhumachis pa'i dus thams cad su zhig gis mngon par sprul cing bslabasashelags/ bka' stsal pa/ thog ma med pa'i ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shes pa'am/bsam par mi nus so/ /gal te 'jig rten du shā ri'i bu lta bur mang du thos par gyur pa'i mi 'ga' zhig byung ste/ des 'di niltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ishedang po gang yin zhes dus ring po mtha' yas par rtag tu bsams kyang 17shes pa'am bsam par mi nus kyi de'i bar skabs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba kho (nyenar zad do/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu chen po lta bu dag phyi ma'i mtha' yas par rtag tu rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis song yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang /zhing bltasnyib rtogs par mi nus te/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa sa bcu thob pa rnams 8kyis kyang de bzhin no/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin no/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta ba de bzhin du sems can 'byung ba yang de kho na bzhin du shes par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byed pa po dang / tshor ba po yang〈nyemachis pa ma lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung byed pa po dang /tshor ba po ni rgyu yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten 'di la bas pa mchis sam/ 'on te ma mchis/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jig rten la ni 63—260

nam yang / ji ltar yang / lan 'ga' yang zad pa med do/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung khyod la dpe bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ji lta bu lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung dper na/ rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa la/mi 'ga' zhig gis skra'i rtse mos bcus na/ ba lang gi mig rjes tsam du 'gyur ram mi 'gyur/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung 'das pa'i dus/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i ches grangs med pa/ bskal pa yangs shing ches yangs pa zhig byung ba/de'i tshe de'i dus na/ 'jig rten du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra gcan7zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das des/ grong khyer chen po 'di nyid du chos bshad pa de'i tshe/ li ts+tsha bī ②gzhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba zhes bya ba 'di/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ 'khor los7sgyurasreba'i rgyal por gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po de/ desabazhin gshegs pa de'i drung du song nas/ des 'byor pa chen po dang / klu'i bskoralab byas nas/ btsun moshedang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das la mchod de / tshig⑧'di dgashegasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ bdag nam zhig na byang chub sems dpar 'gyur lags/ de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' las gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dbang po dang / tshangs pa la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po nyid yod pa ma yin pasal/ de las gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po/ dge bsnyen du gyur pa gang dang gang yin pa de dang de dag ni/ dbang po dang tshangs par 'gyur ro//63—261
