ṣ+ṭṛ 6)te swā hā/ nā ②'o ya ni nī ②la ye swā hā/ tsakra brta kra me swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'byor byed chu khyim snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di bstan ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la sa chen po g.yos par gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed thams cad kyi sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji snyed lhags pa rnams kyang 'dar shig shig ste/ 'khrugs shing skyo ba skyes nas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes 'dzer to④/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal lha mo chen mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dpal cho ga shes khyod kyis ⑤'byor byed chu khyim snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs ni de lta bu yin te/ de'i mthus rtsod pa dang / 'thab ⑥mo thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /klu khro bo dang / ma rungs pa thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin dang ⑦/ mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang /tha na ri dgas po)dang / bya khro bo dang / ma rungs pa thams cad 6)kyang zhi bar byed do/ /dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang / nyi mas gdungs pa dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / than chen thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /lo tog thams 7cad 'phel zhing 'grub par byed do/ /sems can rnams tshe ring bar byed do/ /longs spyod 'phel bar byed do/ /las 'phel ba sgrol bar byed pa'i bar du byed do/ /mya ngan las 'das pa bla na med pa la thug gi bar du dge ba'i chos thams cad kyis nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur ro / /la la zhig gzungs chen po 'di nyan tam/ klog gam/ sgrub par byed na de phyis 'gal ba med pa'i chos dang / sdom pa gsum la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 17sa'i snying pos gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 63—760

'das 'dir bdag gis kyang mtshon cha'i stobs zhes 6)bgyi ba'i gzungs chen po bshad par bgyi'o/ /mtshon cha'i stobs zhes ②bgyi ba'i gzungs des sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa thams cad kyi ched du sa'i bcud thams cad nyams par mi 'gyur lags sog/ /yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur lags sortsi/ /sa'i bcud kyi mdangs rnams gang gis kyang dbrog par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /dbugs gdug pa gtong ba'am/ bskam par yang rngo mi thogs lags so/ /rtsub pa dang / ro ma mchis par bgyi bar (5)rngo mi thogs lags so/ /nyams pa dang ma mchis par bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /dog sa las lo thog 4)mi 'khrung bar (7)bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /rtsub pa dang ske/ ro ma mchis par bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /lo tog gi sa bon dang / myu gu dang / 'dab (8)ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang /'bru dang / sman rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /de la dbugs gdug pa gtong ba'am/ bskam par 6)yang rngo mi thogs lags so/ /rtsub ⑩pa'am/ ro ma mchis par bgyi ba yang rngo mi thogs lags so/ /ma smin pa rnams chab (nyestsal bar yang rngo mi thogs lags so/ /lhags pa dang / tsha ba dag gis tshig pa dang / 'tshal du mi rung bar bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /'tshal ba tsam gyis sems can la la'i lus la dbugs gdug pa gtang bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /gzhi de lta bu las sems can rnams kyis zas 'tshol 4)ba slon nas lto bro 'tshal ba dang / yan lag dang nying lag bro 'tshal cing 'khums hurtepar bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /rims nad dang / brjed byed dang /sems g.yengs 8pa dang / dran pa nyams par bgyid par rngo mi thogs lags 63—761

so / /phan tshun thab 6)mo dang dmag bgyid par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /kha cig srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa la mi ②sbyor ba nas log par lta ba la mi sbyor ba'i bar gyi chos de dag gis sems can rnams kyi sems la sbyor la/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum dang /mi'am ci dang / dri za dang / yi dgas chadang / sha za dang / srul po dang /lus srul po dang / mi dang ④mi ma ⑤yin pa dag gis kyang sems can rnams la gnod pa de lta bu dag bgyi bar rngo mi thogs lags so/ /tad ya thā/ nā bi/ma hā nā bi/ k+ṣu k+ṣa ra nā 0be/ a bing gu/ nā be/ sang gsho ṣa ṇadu/ nā be(1)la/ ni rā dza kha betshu/ a ba ra mu ni/ ta ru ṇa ru he/ na rā 7pad tre/dza ba pra me/ mā tu su ra tro⑩/ ti mi ra pad tre0/ khaṇa ḍa ni ra hā tsore/tsak+ṣa bha se/ ga ṇa bi me/ k+ṣi ⑩ti/ two ye swā hā/ ang gu rak+ṣe 0swā hā/ put+pa ma ye swā hā/ pha la ni ma bhe swā hā/ na mo to ye swā hā/ sha rī ra na ba kra ma bī ṣa 3)swā hā/ dpal cho ga shes khyod kyi yimatshon cha'i stobs zhes 4 )bya ba'i gzungs chen po ni de yin te/ mtshon cha'i stobs zhes ( nyebya ba'i gzungs chen po'i mthu des ni sems can rnams la de lta bur rgyas par byed do/ /bde ba chen po skyed par byed do/ /rgyu des na des sems can rnams myur du 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po de la thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor lhags pa rnams kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin zhing /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ni sems can rnams kyi rtsi sman yin zhing sems can rnams kyi sman par gyur pa'o/ /'di ltar gling bzhi pa 'di'i sems can 63—762

thams cad kyi 'bru dang / rtsi sman yin zhing sdug bsngal thams cad rab tunyezhi bar byed pa'o/ /bde bar sbyar bo thams cad sbyin par byed do/ /snying rje chen po kun nas slong ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o/ /mtshon cha'i stobs zhesashebya ba'i gzungasashechen po shin tu zab pa de lta bu ston pa yin no/ /gzungs chen posnyides ni 'di na sems can rnams kyi sa'i bcud kyi mdangs dang / sa bon dang /myu gu dang / 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / ro dang / 'bru dang / sman rnams mi nyams shing skyon med la7'phel zhing 'byor par byed do/ /sems can gang dag gis zos pa de dag gi rgyud la rtsod pa'i rnyog pa thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /'dir sems can rnams dge ba'i chos thams cad la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /gling bzhi pa 'dir dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang / nyi mas rmugadungs pa dang /tsha ba dang / grang ba dang / char mo che dang / than chen dang / zla ba dang /nyi ma dang / gza' dang / rgyu skarasnyedang / nyin mtshan dang / zla ba dang /zla ba phyed pa dang / lo dang / dus tshigs log pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /gzungs chen po bstan pa des ni nga'i7dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung dang / chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dir mun pa can skal ba chung ba/ rgyags pa dang / dregs pas khengs shing dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa/ rgyal rigs gdol pa dang / blon po gdol pa dag gis 'di ltar nga'i bstan pa dka' bas bsgrubs pa dang / nga'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen〈nyedang / dge bsnyen ma dag la 'tshe bar byed pa nas rgyu des na lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dag 'khrug par mi byed pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du sems can rnams la bde bar sbyar ba thams cad 63—763

'byung ba ni sngar ji skad gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'dus7pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo bco ②lnga pa ri'i snying po'i le'u las than chen rab tu zhi bar byed pa'ishematshon pa ste gsum pa rdzogs sonya// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal lha mo chen mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dpal lha mo0cho ga shes sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal po'i spyan sngar bdag cag gnyis kyis phan tshun dam bcas pa de bzhin du/ bdag cag gnyis kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs shing grub bo/ /de nas dpal lha mo chen mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun rjopa bcom ldan 'das de lta lags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa de lta lags te⑦/ skol gyi bsam pa rdzogs lags so/ /sngon skol gyis de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal po'i spyan sngar phan tshun dam bcas pa bzhin 'di ltar skol gyi bsam pa yongs su grub ste/ da⑥ltar khyod nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa ste 'jig rten du byung ⑨la/ da ltar bdag gis ni dpal gyi go 'phang thob pa lags so/ /da ltar bdag gis sems can rnams la sems can yongs su smin par rngo mi thogs par gyur pa de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di na klu0glang po che lta bu dang ske/ klu rta lta bu dang / klu sbrul lta bu dang / klu nya lta bu dang / klu sbal pa lta bu de dag dus 'dir yang bsgrubalgepar bgyid lags so/ /bdag gis 'jig rten snang bar byed pa zab mo dag bstan (nyepa na gang dag dus ma lags 8pa'i lhags pa dang / tsha ba dang / sprin dang / khug rna dang / rdzi char dang /char mo che dang / than chen dag 'byung bar bgyid pa/ sems can rnams kyi 63—764

lo tog dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / 'bru dang /sman rnams ma rung bar ①bgyid pa'i klu dang / klu chen po de dag ma bskrad lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dus 'dir da ltar gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu'i 'khor dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u7dang / bu mo dang / gling bzhi pa 'di na gang kha cig klu'i skye gnas pa de dag thams cad da ltar 'dir mchis pa rnams dang /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag da ltar 'dus pa chen po 'dir mchis pa rnams dang / da ltar 'dir lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lha ma yin dang / sto 'phye chen po dang / yi dgasashedang ske/ sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po 'dus pa thams cad dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dngasnyi/ mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag da ltar 'dus pa chen po 'dir chos nyan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis pa'i sems can de dag thams cad zas bzhi la rten cing 'tsho bar bgyid lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da lta'i dus su klu khro bo phung bar bgyid pa dag zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gang dag klu khro bo rnams ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la mngon par ma dad pas rtag par yang sgrub par bgyid pa/ sems can rnams la tho 'tshams pa/ sems can rnams kyi longasakyispyod pa dang nye bar ⑧spyod pa dag ma rung ⑨bar bgyid pa/ 'jig rten pha rol la mi lta ba/sems can rnams la snying brtse ba ma mchis shing snying rje ma mchis par zhugs pa/snang ba/ rtsub pa lags te/ bdag sems can yongs su smin par bgyid pa la 63—765

bar chad bgyid pa lags pas/ de dag gi ①don du bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rje chen po bskyed du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi sdig pa de thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i gnas na gnas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri'i snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar klu yongs su smin par brtson pas smon lam btab pa ci 'dra zhe na/ sngon dang /da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi klu dang / klu chen po klu khro bo skye gnas bzhi pa dag dbugs gdug⑧pa dang / klu rnams kyi mig gdug pa dang / reg pa gdug⑧pa dang / lce gdug pa dang / 'dod chags kyi0dug dang / zhe snang gi dug dang / gti mug gi dug dang / klu khro bo rnams kyi sdig pa'i chos dag ci nas kyang chos dang ldan pas bsal bar nus par bya'o/ /ci nas kyang klu khro bo de dag gis sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod pa dang /yo byad sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams la gnod par mi 'gyur bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum po de dag la dad pa dang / dang ba dang /rjo dga' ba thob par bya'o/ /du'ajig rten pha rol la lta ba dang bcas shingasnyisdig pa'i chos rnams dang 'bral7bar 'gyur bar bya'o zhes smon lam btab bo/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri'i tisnying pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gang dag klu khro bo de dag ni gnas der zhugs te mchis nas klu rnam par bsgyings pa'i gnas zhes7bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gnas par bgyi lags so/ dzoting nge 'dzin gyi mthus bdag gis de dag gi 63—766

khro ba dang / nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / 'dod chags de dag nye bar zhi bar bgyi lags so/ /de dag 'jam pa dang / snod du rung ba dang / sems zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / sems 'jig rten pha rol la lta7bar 'gyur ba dang /sems can thams cad la sems byams pa dang / snying rje ba dang / snying brtsesab dang / sems brtse ba can du 'gyur bar bgyi lags so/ /klu khro bo dang /klu ma rungs pa rnams dad par 'gyur bar bgyi lags sos/ /sems can thams cad la mi 'tshe zhing snying brtse0ba can gyi sems kyi sa la gnas par bgyi lags so/ /gzhan yang gang dag rdzi char dang / char mo che dang / than chen dang /sprin dang / sprin chen dang / lhags pa dang / tsha ba dag gis gnod par gyur pa'i sems can de dag gis thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gi ming brjod nas 'di skad du ri'i snying po thugs rje rgya che ba/ klu yongs su smin par mdzad pa/bdag cag dran lags so/ / dran lags so/ ༷bla na med pa'i byang chub la spyod par mdzad pa/ thabs dang ye shes sna tshogs la brtson pas mi spyod lags sam/ bdag cag sdug bsngal las thar0bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su bskyabakhutu gsol zhes smra ba dag gis 'di skad du brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/stam bha bhu dza/ bi re ḍū 67dza/ go gha bi re dz+ra bhu dza/ me ru bhu dza/ ga tu ba bhu dza/ k+shi /⑨/ a ne ba bhu dza/ sma ra bhu dza/ sma ra a brta bhu dza/ ni ma ba bhu dza swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sems can gang kha cig klu khro bo de dag gi rgyus gnod pa dag gis gnod pa bgyis par gyur ⑩pa de lta bu de dag gis bdag giloming nas brjod par bgyi zhing / klu khro boyi/ nga rgyal can/dregs pa/ phrag dog dang / 'dod chags kyi sems zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du 63—767

gsang sngags 'don pa na bdag gis lha'i rna ba rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas thos nas skye gnas bzhi pa'i klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu rgan po dang /klu'i bu dang / klu'i 'khor rnams dad par ma bgyis sam/ dus ma lags par don ched ya nga ba la zhugs panyedag ma bzlog gam/ de'i tshe dus ma lags pa'i char mo che dang / than chen⑧dang / dus ma lags pa'i lhags pa dang / tsha ba dang / rlung dang / sprin dang / 'khrug pa dag rab tu zhi bar ma bgyis samanyaske/ bdag gis bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis sems can de dag gi bsam pa dag yongs su rdzogs par ma bgyis na/ bdag gis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bslus par gyur cig /bdag nyid kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis sngon 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'khor tshogs pa dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du smon lam brtan por btab ste / shin tu gnas par gyur lags so/ /de'i 'og tu yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag snyed 'tsho zhing gzhes pa 'khor tshogs pa dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar smon lam brtan po 'di lta bu dag btab ste/bdag gis der rtag par sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du pha rol gnon pa'i brtson 'grus chen pos shin tu brtan par gnas par bgyi'o zhes brtson par bgyis lags so/ /da ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yang klu khro bo rnams yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du rtsol ba brtan por dubagyis la/bdag gis de lta bu'i rtsol6)ba brtan pos brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni bskal pa 63—768

grangs ma mchis par skad cig tsam yang btangatum myong lags so/ /bdag gis rtag par pha rol gnon pa'i rtsol ba dang / brtson pa brtan pos sems can yongs su smin par bgyis lags pa rnams kyang yang yongs su smin par bgyi lags so/ /gzhan yang bdag gis klu'i dbang po dag theg pa chen po'i spyod pa la brtson par bgyis lags te/ klu glang po che rnams kyi bdag po klu'i rgyal po shin tu rab gnas 'di dang / klu sbrul rnams kyi bdag po klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang ske/ bsnyen dga'algebo 'di gnyis dang / klu rta rnams kyi bdag po klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa 'di dang / klu nya rnams kyi bdag po klu'i rgyal po chu lha dang / klu sbal pa rnams kyi bdag po klu'i rgyal po yid bzangs7'di rnams te④/ klu de lta bu dag ni sems can rnams la gnod pa bgyid par rngo thogs pa dag go/ /klu'i rgyal po gzhan de lta bu de dag kyang rang rang gi mthus sems can rnams la de lta bur gnod pa bgyid par rngo thogs pa dag go/ /'di ltar theg pa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i rgyal po chen po de dag thams cad kyis kyang so so rang rang gi 'khor dang / dpung gi tshogs rnams dus ma lags par de lta bur ya nga ba dubasgrubs pasasherang rang gi 'khor rnams bskyon⑧par bgyid lags so/ /'di ltar 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi7bstan pa chos sgron ma dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung myur du mi 'chad par bgyi ba'i slad du 'khor der mchis pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri'i snying po klu'i drang srong la legs so zhes bgyi ba stsal to/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po shin tu rab gnas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag la rtenas(me63—769

pa'i klu dang / klu'i rgyal po gang dag sgo nga las skye btudang / mngal nas skye bsnyedang / drod dang gsher las skye ba dang / rdzus te skye ba'i klu de dag gang na bcom ldan 'das kyi ②'khor nyan thos rnams dang / 'khor byang chub sems dpa' de dag la phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / yul 'khor der sha khon ma mchis pa'i sems kyisakhuganas par 'gyur lags so/ /gnod sems ma mchis pa dang / sems mnyam pas gnas par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag yul 'khor de'i rgyal po de dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la sems shin tu dad par 'gyur lags so/ /de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa yang 'dzin par 'gyur lags so/ /dbang phyug gis rgyags pa dang dregs pas bcom ldan 'das kyisnyibastan pa 'jig par mi 'gyur lags so/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen7dang / dge bsnyen ma dag la 'tshe bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du rab tu byung nas skra bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos pa/ snod du gyur pa dang /snod du ma gyur pa lhag pa'i bsam pa can rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan7pa 'dzin par bgyid lags so/ /gzhan yang yul 'khor de na gang dag mi rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa de'i tsher mar 'gyur pa de dag chos dang ldan pas skyod par bgyid lags so/ /de nas yul 'khor der dge sbyong dang /bram ze bsod snyoms pa rnams la sngon gyi rgyal po dag gis sngon lhag pa'i bsam pas sbyin pa phul ba rnams rgyal rigs dge bas 'phrog par mi bgyid la/ rgyal rigs dge ba blon po dang / mdun na5)'donachadang / skye bo dmag mi rnams dang bcas pas tshogs sbyor ba7ni don ched la brtson pa lags so/ /snying po 63—770

blangs pa lags so/ /lag brkyang nas lhug par gtong ba lags te①/ rgyal rigs dge ba de yul 'khor dang bcas par srungasnyibar bgyi lags so/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi lags so/ /de'i yul phyogs na rtsod pa'i rtog pa thams cad dang / so so'i 'khor dag sngar ji skad bstan pa bzhin bskrad par bgyi lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos gos ngur smrig kha bsgyur ba 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabasalgepa lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyal mtshan lags so/ /mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba rnams kyi lam lags so/ /nyon mongs pa rnams kyi ral gri lags so/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon lags so/ /lam las rab tu nyams pa rnams kyi sgron ma lags so/ /phung po rnams kyi sman lags so/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa'i rlung lags so/ /ngan 'gro rnams kyi srog0shing lags so/ /nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis nyams par gyur pa rnams kyi skyug sman lags so/ /dgra rnams kyi rdo rje lags so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi gter lags so/ /sdig pas gos pa rnams kyi chab lags so/ /nongs pa bgyid pa rnams kyi me long lags so/ /sems g.yengs pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin lags so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi za ma tog lags so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi sa gzhi dulags so/ /gzungs rnams kyi nor bu lags so/ /bzod pa rnams kyi khyim lags so/ /sa rnams kyi snod lags so/ /phas kyikhurgol ba rnams kyi mkhar lags so/ /nad pa rnams kyi sman pa lags so/ /bslab pa rnams kyi ri lags so/ /nyon mongs pas kun nas gdungs pa rnams kyi zla ba lags so/ /lta ba ngan par ltung7ba rnams kyi nyi ma lags so/ /ye shes kyi rgya mtsho lags so/ /byang chub kyi phyogs 63—771

pa rnams kyi phreng bar gyur pa lags so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bum pa bzang po lags so/ /chos gos ngur smrigatu'adi ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ba lags so/ /chos gos ngur smrig 'di ni sems can rnams la chos kyi char dbab pa'i don gyi slad du sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gang dag rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'jig par bgyid cing dge slong dag la tho 'tshamasalgepar bgyid pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du rab tu byung ba snod du gyur pa dang / snod du ma gyur pa'i lus la gnod pa bgyid pa dang / nor 'phrog pa dang / srog gi bar chad dag bgyid pa'i bar du'o/ /yul 'khor der gang dag sangs rgyas la dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / grul bum dang /yi dgas semathu bo che de dag thams cad kyang rgyal rigs gdol pa la gshe bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis de'i yul 'khor du thabasremo dang / rtsod pa dang / lo nyes dang / nad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dag 'byung bar bgyid lags soXske/ /dus ma lags pa'i char mo che dang / than chen dang / lhags pa dang /tsha ba dang / rlung dang / nyi mas gdungs pa dag gis sa bon dang / myu gu dang ske/ 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / 'bru dang / sman dang ske/ ro rnams ma rung bar⑥bgyid kyang de na klu rnams la skyon ni ma mchis lags te/ de na klu rnams rgyu des na grags pa ma lags pas ni gos par 'gyur lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na yul gyi bud med bzang mos zas ngan pa 'tshal na stidabugs dri mi bda' ⑧bar 'gyur lags so/ /63—772

de bzhin du rgyal rigs gdol pas kyang rgyal rigs kyi chos rnams spangs nas dmangs rigs kyi chos rnams spyod par bgyid ①na/ yul phyogs thams cad srung ba'i lha nas yi dgasalgemathu bo che dag gi bar du khros par 'gyur te/ de dag gis yul 'khor ma rung bar bgyid la/ klu dang kluphuchen po rnams grags pa ma lags pas kyang gos par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i bdag po rgyal po rnams rgyal po'i bslab pa'i gzhi gnas par bstan pa de dang de dag mtho ris dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba la brtson pa yin no/ /gang dag rgyal rigs gdol pa rgyal rigs kyi bslabalgepa la mi gnas pa de dag ni sems can dmyal 6)ba mnar med pa'i bar la gzhol ba yin no/ /klu'i bdag po nga rang gi 'khor bslab pa las mi 'da' bar bstan pa des na de dag da ltar ⑦gyi dus dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus su nga'i bstan pa dang ske/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung med par mi byed par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de ltamanyelags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa de ltawolags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das yul 'khor gang dang gang dag na grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang /ri brags kyitshwanyeganas yul 'khor de na bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos tshul khrims dang ldan zhing thos pa mang po sbyin gnas de lta bu dag gnas shing77mchis pa der bdag gi 'khor gang dag klu dang / klu mo dang / klu rgan po dang / klu rgan mo dang ske/ klu'i bu pho dang / klu'i bu mo dang / klu'i 'khor pho dang / klu'i 'khor mo rnams dus ma lags par rdzi char dang / ser drag dang / char mo che dang ske/ than chen dag gtong bar bgyid dam/ lhags mo che dang / shin tu tsha 63—773

ba dang / nyi mas gdungs pa dag 'byung bar bgyid dam/ sems can rnams kyi lo tog dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / 'bru dang / sman gyi ro dang ske/ longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dag chab 'tshal bar bgyid na klu de dag gis bdag bslus pas de'i lus thams cad 'khums par gyur cig /de dag rdzu 'phrul dang bral nas 'gro mi nus par gyur ①cig /rims nad kyis gdungs par gyur cig /longs spyod thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /spobs pa med par gyur cig /don ②byed mi nus par gyur cig ces mnas bsgrag par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ nā ga dzan du she/ nā ga me ne/② nā ga dha ra gyu gh+ra gyu gh+ra/ dza la gyu gh+ra/ a bi mā ra ge/ sa ha sra mu khe/ ka la ti ma pu se/nā ga ④stam bha ri/ dza ya ba pha le/ bi mu sha kre swā hā/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis de nyid du legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nyid kyi tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i klu'i 'khor rnams shugs drag por 'khrugs shing dngangs rjopar gyur to/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo gnyis stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag gzhan la sbyin par ma dad cing bdag nyid longs spyod par 'tshal la/ 'jungs pa longs spyod la sems kun du 'dzin cing lag mi skyongakhu/bas dge sbyong dang / bram ze'udang / bkren pa dang /phongs ⑨pa dang / 'gron tho )po slong ba rnams kun nas tshim par mi bgyid (sprelags so/ /pho brang 'khor hunyedang / ljongs kyi mi dang / 'khor rnams yang dag pa'i bde bas tshim par mi bgyid lags so/ /rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag 63—774

la yul phyogs srung ba'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /lha ma yin dang / grul bum dang / yi dgasatumathu bo che de dag thams cad kyang khros par gyur te/ de dag gisayul 'khor du thabashemo dang / rtsod pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dngasre/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dag kun du 'byung bar bgyid lags so/ /'bru dang sman gyi bar gyi7ro rnams ma rung bar bgyid 0kyang de na klu dang / klu chen po rnams la skyon ni ma mchis lags te/de na klu rnams rgyu des na gragasalgepa ma lags pas ni gosalgepar 'gyur lags so//btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ⑨dper bgyi ⑩na phyi nyunyes khung gi dri mi bda' tunyeb bser mas 'tshal na 'dri mi bda' 8bar 'gyur (nyeb de bzhin du/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal rigs gdol pa rnams kyis kyang yul phyogs thams cad srung ba dag khros par gyur te/ yul 'khor de ma rung b.rasnyibagyid lags so/ /klu rnams kyang grags pa mtshwanyelags pas gos par 'gyur lags so// //bam po gsum pa ste tha tso)/ yang na klu thams cad bdag gi bslab pa las mi 'da'0 bar bdag gis lung dbog par bgyi ste/ yul 'khor gang dang gang dag na grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri brags kyi nyaganas yul 'khor de na da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos tshul khrims dang ldan zhing thos pa mang po sbyin gnas de lta bu dag gnas shing mchis pa der bdag gi 'khor gang dag klu dang / klu mo dang /klu rgan pho0 dang / klu rgan mo dang /zhu) klu'i bu pho dang / klu'i bu mo dang /klu'i 'khor pho dang / klu'i 'khor mo sgo nga las skye ba dang / mngal nas steskye ba dang / drod gsher las skye ba dang / rdzus te skye ba dag dus ma lags par rdzi 63—775

char dang / ser drag dang / char mo che dang / than chen dag gtong bar bgyid ①dam/ lhags mo che dang / shin tu tsha ba dang / nyi mas gdungs pa dag 'byung bar bgyid dam/ sems can rnams kyi lo tog⑧dang / me tog dang ske/ 'bras bu dang / 'bru dang / sman dang / ro dang / longs spyod dang ske/ yongs su spyod pa dag chab 'tshal bar bgyid na klu de dag gis bdag bslus pas de'i lus thams cad 'khums par gyur cig /de dag rdzu 'phrul dang bral nas7'gro mi nus par gyur cig /rims nad kyis gdungs par gyur cig /longs spyod thams cad dang bral bar gyur cigadu /spobs pa med par gyur cig /don byed mi nus par gyur cig ces mnas bsgag par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ /rna gyu me/ ku ma bha rak+ṣi/ bar ma gu ṇi/ āloka la k+ṣe/ bai sha deX/ bi mārga k+ṣe/ku na bi ra ge/ a ta sa le/ na yan tu ma sge/ kā la ku she/ nang gu pra bho/gan dha ra pa se swā hā/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des legs so/ /zhes bgyi ba stsal lags so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa zhes bya ba nas sngarasheji skad gsungs pa'i bar du'o/ /tabya thā/ na ba bhi she/ na ba na ma bhi she/ā no k+ṣe/ na ba kuñdza bhi k+ṣidu/ kha ga bai kha/ sa ra thon rgyal/ pā pā ⑨ ya si le / na rā ya 977gu ṇi/ bi na sterwa)le/ da sha kra mi/ a k+ṣu d+marwanyenye se/ ā ni sa be swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po chu lha zhes bya ba nas sngar ji skad gsungs pa'i bar du'o / /tar+ya thā/ hi ma be me/ parnyuli k+ṣi ṇa0)gu te⑩/ ru ṇalo)bin du tri ṇi'/tsa rak+ṣa dha re/ me gha sang kra0)me/ byā pu ṭu kerwa )she/ drumanyamo de/ mā 3ye ta na ku se/ tsa ra ma hi ke /tsa lang ge rte/ nā nā dasto(ste/ ka ṭu ka 65nyele swā hā / sngar ji skad gsungs pa'i bar du'o/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po yid bzangs 63wa 776

stanatulas langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de'ulogs su thal mo sbyar ba btudakunas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag la rten pa'i klu dang / klu chen po de dag ni sgo nga las skye ba dang / mngal nas skye ba dang / drod gsher las skye ba dang / rdzus te skye ba dag lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su〈rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag gis rgyal rigs kyi chos spangs nas dmangs rigs kyi chos rnams spyod par bgyid de/ sems can dmyal ba mnar ma mchis pa'i bar dag la gzhol ba lags7so/ /rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag gi skyon gyis klu rnams ma nongs bzhin du grags pa ma lags pas7gos par 'gyur lags so/ /rgyu des na klu rnams las kyi sgrib pa dag bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /de lta lags pas bdag cag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la bkur sti bgyi zhing gzung skyabar bgyi ste/ dper bgyi na 'khor los sgyur nyurtaba'i rgyal po des yul gyi bud med bzang mo khrus legs par bgyis te spos kyis byugs nas gos mchog tu bzang ba bskon5nyete/ yan lag gi dam pa mgo bo la rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i phreng ba mang po dag btags shing dpung rgyan dang / gser skud dang / sor gdub dang / lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dag gis brgyanarwanyenas glang po che'i bzhonasapa la bskyon 7te/ 'khor phal mo che dang lhan cig khrid pa de bzhin du da ltar 'khor los sgyur tsoba'i rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang bdag cag klu rnams dud 'gro'i skye gnas su bsdus pa'i lus ma snad ma nyams la/ mchog tu khro rmo/ phob dang / nga rgyal dang / dregs pa'i dri mas bsgos pa/ bdag cag klu thams cad rgyags pas myos pa ma mchis pa'i chos kyi hu)chus 63—777

bkrus lags so/ /bdag cag la ngo tsha shes7pa dang / khrel yod pa'i gos bskon⑧lags so/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu7rtsa bdun gyi phreng bas bcings lags so/ /bdag cag gi sems dang / yid dang / rnam0par shes pa dag bzod pa dang / gzungs dang / sa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan lags so/ /theg pa chen po'i shing rta dag gis btegakyilags so/ /gang na sangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga dang bral ba shin tu yongs su dag par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs yongs su dag pas bskor nas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi gtam medag pa dag niston pa der bdag cag mchi7lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ da ltar bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la bkur sti bgyid cing 'dzin par bgyid lags so/ /de lta lags pas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la shin tu gnas par bgyid lags so/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang ske/ ljongs dang / ri brags kyi gnas gang dang gang na sems can nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa dang / theg pa chen po pa dag khyim na gnas pa'am/ rab tu byung ba'am/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am / tshul khrims 'chal pa'am/ thos pa mang ba'am/ thos pa nyung ba'am/brtson 'grus brtsams pa'am/ le lo can nam/ mnyam par gzhag pa'am/mnyam par ma gzhag pa'am/ dran pa dang ldan pa'am/ dran pa nyams pa rnams bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims dag la dga' zhing dad pa dang / bkur ⑩ste dang /bla mar bgyid pa dang / ri mo7bgyid pa dang / byang chub rnam gsum gang 63—778

yang rung ba dag la rab tu zhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos sbyin gnas ①de lta bu dag gnas shing mchis pa de dang der bdag cag yid kyis dga' zhing dad pa dang / bkur sti dang / bla mar bgyi ba dang / ri mo dag gis gnas par bgyikhulags so/ /yul 'khor de dang de'i grong dngasnye/ grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri brags der bdag gi 'khor klu dang / klu mo dang / klu rgan pho dang / klu rgan mo dang / klu'i bu dang /klu'i bu mo dang / klu'i 'khor pho dang / klu'i 'khor mo dag dus ma lags par rdzi char dang / ser drag dang / char mo che dang / than chen dag gtong bar bgyid dam/ lhags mo che dang / shin tu tsha ba dag 'byung bar bgyid dam/sems can rnams kyi lo tog dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ 'bru dang / sman gyi ro dang / longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dag chab 'tshal bar bgyid na klu de dag gis bdag bslus pas de dag thams cad kyi lus 'khums par gyur cig /de dag rdzu 'phrul nyams nas 'gro mi nus par gyur cig /rims nad kyis kun tu gdungs par gyur cig /dbang po thams cad ma tshang bar gyur cig /longs spyod dang yongs su spyod pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /las byed mi nus par gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ bud dha dza ye/ bā la k+ṣe/ a ma ni me/ bhu tasnyis li le/ a na mang rjetso/ pra t+ya ni le/ a ba ni la me/ khi la sho me/ nastu 37pi hā5)le/ dzi sa dzi5)tā/skan dha 57le/ bha ra ni kri ye swā hā/ der thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji snyed lhags pa rnams bzhinasnyidang mig yid du 'ong bas shin tu dgod cing thal mo sbyar nas legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'di skad du skyes bu dam pa khyod sems 63—779

can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa yin te/ skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis de ltar bya ba ni legs so legs so zhes smras nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i klu'i 'khor de dag shugs drag pos ①'khrugs shing dngangs ②la kun tu 'gul zhing mngon par mi dga' ba dang kun tu 'khor bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe dri za'i drang srong dga' bar7'byung ba zhes bya ba stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dbaltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gang dag rgyal rigs gdol pa blun po mkhas so snyam pa'i nga rgyal can nga rgyal dang rgyags pas nyams pa/ 'jig rten pha rol la mi ltabatso / g.yo sgyu can/ snying rje ma mchis pa/ dge slong la tho 'tshams par bgyid pa nas tha na bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du skyabs dusu mchis nas nye bar gnas pa/ spa bregs7te gos ngur smrig bgos pa la tho 'tshamasalgepa dag 'byung ste / bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du rab tu byung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs spu pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'bar bar bgyid pa dag la tho 'tshams71pa'i rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis mnas bsgag par bgyi ba ni longs spyod kyis 'khrugs par gyur cig /rgyal phran gyis 'khrugs par gyur cig /rgyal pos 'khrugs par gyur cig /nang dmag dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dag gis 'khrugs par gyur cig /chu med pas 'khrugs par gyur cig /nad kyis 'khrugs par gyur cig /gzas 'khrugs par gyur cig /bya ma rtas 'khrugs par gyur cig /rtse dgas 'khrugs par gyur cig /pha tsho/)tshan gyis 'khrugs par gyur cig /'khor gyis 'khrugs 63—780

par gyur cig /'byung ba chen pos 'khrugs par gyur cig /yi dgas ①mthu bo ches 'khrugs par gyur cig ces bgyi ba nas/ rgyal rigs kyis 'khrugs par gyur cig /bram ze dang / dmangs rigs dang / bud med dang / seng ge dang ske/ stag dang / spyang gi⑧dag gis 'khrugs par gyur cig ces bgyi ba'i bar du rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag mnas bsgag⑧par bgyi lags so/ /tabya thā / ba de ya ba na pa le/ ma hā brta༄na n+t+rayi/ dru ma ts+tsha te④/ ku su mad/ba ra shel/ yu ga te⑩/ sam bhā k+ṣe/ rtswa ma57dri hā51k+ṣi/ sa lo5)pa nā spuya/pa ri bā8ri/ bhū ma dru kra me/ ne+e ran ta na/ dza si la me na tro 7/ bai ma ba ta/ ma shā khā dzoste/ na ya na hing ku le/ pi57bad tsha/ bh+ri se/ dha na mu tse/ sang ga byo k+ṣidu/ pa la min dha da lete/ 65)mi pasne/ ro5nyem da le/ba na ga dzi/ tū ṭa pa ṭi/ ā5nyepa ṭi nyedu ce/ na ya dri5nyesbyi/ dzi hā zhunakra ne/u ta rak+ṣe/ gan dhar te ⑥si mi swā hā/ gang dag rgyal rigs gdol pa 'jig rten pha rol la mi lta zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams la tho 'tshams bye pa de dag de ltar gyur cig /de'i tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i dri za'i 'khor rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la tho 'tshams5nyepar bgyid pa'i rgyal rigs gdol pa de dag la bdag cag ci dgaramurtebagyid du stsal du gsol/ bdag cag rang rang gi gnas na rtsed mo la chags shing yongs su spyod par bgyid dam/ dga' skyidapa nyams su myong bar bgyid na bdag cag kyang mna'i khongs su gtogs par gyur cig /de'i tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji snyed lhags pa rnams kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying pos bcom ldan 63—781

'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rnam par rtse ba mngon par shes pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi srog shing zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgo chen po bshad par bgyi ste/ rgyal mtshan gyi srog shing zhes bya ba'i gzungs chen po'i hu)sgo gang gi rna lam du grag ②pa de'i rna ba'i nad dag rab tu zhi bar bgyid do / /de'i 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug la sogs pa nyon mongs pa rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyid do/ /gal te na bsrabs par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho'i shun pa man dza na la gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di lan 'bum bzlas ②brjod bgyis nas rgyal rigs kyi rnga la bskus nas rnga de'i sgra gang dang gang gi ④rna lam du grag ⑤pa de dang de'i 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti dumug la sogs pa nyon mongs pa rnams bsrabs par 'gyur ro/ /de dang de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦bstan pa la shin tu dga' zhing bkur (8)ste dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor 9)byed pa dag rab tu 'thob ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rjes su 'brang bas 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pha rol la lta ba dang /longs spyod dang yongs su spyod pa dang mi 'bral la sems can thams cad kyi mig ⑩tu 'ong ba dang / snying du sdug par 'gyur ro/ /tabya thā/ purba 0mārga a ma lo ma ti0/ k+ṣiti la0/ byu mabe+e pra 7na kha na/ ḍi ⑩dun khi le/ mas tū snyi/le/gi ra sa na k+ṣa ba ra me3)/ bud+dha ra shrī tsha )piṅga le sgri me/ lo ho 0tā ra snyes/naṅga la sru rī 3/ bha ga ba ri ṇi mi/ an dharba sa.u re/ ka ra hru zhu nyadze/ ke sha lo hi(nye/ sa mā dhi dhu re zhu swā hā/ de nas de nyid du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs so zhes bya ba gnang ngo / /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des kyang 63—782

legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung dbyangs dang / sgra brjod par bgyid pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam gyi tshul zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs chen po de bshad par 'tshal gyis①/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bdag la rjes su yi rang bar mdzad du gsol/ de ni mthu che zhing stobs che la pha rol gnon pa snang bar bgyid pa chen po lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams kyi thos pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i gter dang / ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i gter du 'gyur ba lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sdom pa la gnas pa 'di lta ste/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / dge sbyong gi sdom pa dang /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa snod du gyur pa dang / snod du ma gyur pa dag gis gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam gyi tshul zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs chen po 'di lhag mthong gi sbyor bas nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du klog na phyir zhing nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po ②dag la rtog par 'gyur ro/ /nyin mtshan bdun 'das nas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs chen po lan 'bum snyed du yang dngasheyang dran par bgyid pa de ni rgyal rigs rnams dang / bram ze'i rigs rnams dang / rje'u rigs rnams dang /dmangs rigs rnams dad par bgyid pa nas sems can thams cad kyi bar du shin tu mngon par dad par bgyid pa lags so/ /thams cad longs spyod pa dang / yongs su spyod pa rgya chen po mchog dang mi 'bral zhing mtho ris la gzhol 63—783

bar 'gyur lags so/ /de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /tabya thā/ tri ṇi sang ①nyi ke/ bi trisaṇa bi ma be/ ka ra mā k+ṣe/ bhu ta sru me7tsa/ pa ra dzi7me/ a bha k+ṣe/a k+ṣa ya lo bezhu/ argyad7)ma/ ni mi re/ shrīkhuta bishesta re/ ang〈pe gu dza dha tshwa(7te/ dza dza ra no7so a na sa shudhe/ mṛ ga sgri5stek+ṣi/ ku la ba ṭi/ ma ga bā bā / k+ṣe lhasab swa re/ a bhi ti matsobyu re/ sumanyer kha dze smre ti mo ni swānehā/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad ⑩/pa la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam gyi tshul zhes bya(3 ba'i gzungs chen po 'di bshad pas sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi〈 tethos pa'i mig5)kun tu ston par byed la/ nga'i bstan pa yang rton bupar byed pa ni legs so legs so/ /de nas de nyid du thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'di skad du skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam zhes bya ba'i gzungs chen po 'di rdzogs par bshad pas da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyi thos stepa mang po'i tshogs rgyas par byed pa dang ston pa ni skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /de'i tshe 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gling bzhi pa 'di'i me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ shing dang / 'bru dang / sman dang / lo tog dag bsrungamanyebar 63—784

'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dang /〈tudang / 'dabarkum dang / lo ma sa la rten⑧pa rnams bsrung bar 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das nang gu dpal rdul zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs7chen po de dasheltar 'dir7gling bzhi pa de dag gis sngon ma thos ma mthong bas 'di ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar gyur te/ 'dus pa chen po de lta bu dag byung ⑨bar bgyis lags so/ /nang gu dpal tshi rdul zhes bya ba'i gzungs chen po 'di ni mthu che bas lo tog thams cad 'phel bar bgyid pa lags so/ /sa bon dang /myu gu dang / sdong bu dang / 'dabasngormem dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ shing dang / 'bru dang / sman dang / ro rnams skyed 12par bgyid pa dang / 'phel bar bgyid pa dang / snum mchis par bgyid tunyepa dang /'jam par bgyid pa dang / mang por bgyid pa lags so/ /sems can thams cad dad par bgyid pa dang / tshul khrims can du bgyid pa dang / thos par bgyid pa dang / shes par bgyid pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje can du bgyid pa dang / thabs dang ldan par bgyid pa nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad kyi bar du ston par bgyid pa lags so/ /tar+ya thā/ a na n+ya 67mi/ga 'i7snyibi dze/ gu lo tsa lo me/ phaṭa tsik+ṣa lo me/ shrī yak+ṣa ku su me/ na〈nyeb ku mun5)khe/ rā dza bar me/ tsa ṭa na ba/ ba ma ṭi/ bi 677lang ge/ /a ba bha su ne/ ha sa ga bha rdu )ge/ lo ma bhu dzam〉k+ṣi/ gam bhi ra pa su me/ a no ma ya sa re/ pa lāmanyesha to ye swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nang gu dpalasardul zhes bgyis steba'i gzungs chen po 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te sgreng gebar bgyid dam/ skad chen por sgrog gam/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di chu la 63—785

lan stong gi bar du bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ zhing dang / shing dang / lo tog ①sna tshogs la gtor tam/ rnga dang / rdza rnga ②dang / dung dag ③la bsngags nasaX/ de dag gi sgra gang du thos pa'i lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu dang / 'bru dang / sman gyi ro0dang / sa la rten pa'i lo togashethams cad sems can rnams kyi sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa'i rgyu lus7pa ma gtogs par lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / yi dgas7mthu bo che dang /bdud dang / bdud kyi bu dang / bdud kyi 'khor gyi tshogs gang gis kyang gnod par bgyi ba'am/ chud gzon pa'am/ tshig par bgyi ba'am/ bskam pa'am/ mdangs 'phrog57pa'am/ mthu chung bar bgyi ba'am/ ma mchis par bgyi ba dag tu rngo mi thogs na sems can dang / sems can gyi grangs su gtogs pa gzhan dag gis lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de tunyel legs so zhes bya ba 6)gnang ste/rigs kyi bu khyod gling bzhi pa 'dir sbyin pa chen po'i dpal gyi shing rta la zhon nas / rigs kyi bu 'dir bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam du sems can dpag tu med pa rnams rton par byed pa ni rigs kyi bu khyod legs so legs so/ /de nas de nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor thams cad kyis kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur〈nyepa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar byas pa ni legs so legs so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byams pa khyod la bdag gis7dpal me tog sar pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs chen po sbyin gyis( tre/ gzungs chen po des na0)rigs kyi bu khyod 63—786

kyis byams pa chen po'i go bgos nas/ 'dir sems can rnams la tshig gis chos ston na ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i chos de dag sems can gang dag gis thos pa'i sdig pa'i sems dang / sdig pa'i lta ba dag spong bar byed do/ /sdig pa'i grogs po dang / sdig pa'i bshes 6)gnyen dag spong bar byed do/ /sems kyis byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dag yid la byed par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la snying brtse ②ba dang ske/ sems 'jig rten pha rol la lta ba can du 'gyur ro/ /sems mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dag las ldog par 'gyur ro/ /sems dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dag la rnam par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sems sems can thams cad la mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs chen po 'di ni/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir chos kyi char 'bebs par byed pa'og/ /dgra thams cad rab tu dad par byed cing bshes ④gnyen thams cad mngon par 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /tar+ya thā/ li ba ta swa (gere/ kā shā ya/ bar me/ sa me bag ghi/ dā phyirang ga dza le/ su to k+ṣe/ gsu ma hā 6)bha k+ṣa re/ su ha bung yo)ge/ gau a ba lo ka da le/ sid dhi bhi ⑩ba k+ṣe/ dh+ya ⑪nan r+pā tsob re/ a bi na dha lung be/ so tsa ra tsa la/ a ba bha sa re/ ba rā ⑫ha sharjetso / e ka hā tsod to leyi/ sa mā dhi ka ra khe7/ bā (srel dza bi ti/ ma hā dā yibyu ta ku se/ a ra ṇa ni ⑥ le/ mā lā (nyem sha (nyeme/ ni so la ku su me swā hā / dpal me tog ser po ( /zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di yini byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyod kyis tsobyams pa chen po'i go bgos nas sems can rnams la chos ston na/ de'i sgra tha na sems can srog chags su gyur pa phra mo 63—787

chung7ngu gang dag gi rna lam du grag⑧pa de dag gi sems kyi rnyog pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang / de dag gi sems dge ba'i rtsa ba la gnasalgepar yang 'gyur na mir gyur pa rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ sems can la la dag gis char dbab pa'i phyir dri za dang / klu'i gnas dag tu gzungs chen po 'di bzlas brjod byas te/ na le sham gyi phye ma dang / e raṇa ḍa'i mar du bsres pa la des lan stong du bsngags nas/ gos kyi mtha' mar phur ma byas te khron par bcug na/ des na de la klu rnams dga' bar 'gyur te/ char gyi rgyun chen po yang 'bebs par byed do/ /de'i tshe yul der 'dus pa'i klu dang / klu chen po rnams kyis dpal me tog sar pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs chen po 'di thos nas sems rangs pa dang / sdang sems med pa dang / sems rab tu dga' ba dang ske/ sems byams pa dang ldan pa dang / sems 'jig rten pha rol la lta bar gnas par gyur to④/ /sems dkon mchog gsum la dad cing / bkur sti dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor7byed pa dag thob par gyur to7/ /sems dud 'gror skye ba'i rang gi sdig pa'i las dag rab tu 'chags () pa dang /sems theg pa chen po bla na med pa la 'jug par gnas par gyur to/ /klu dang /klu chen po de dag thams cad kyi nang nas mthu ci yod pa dang / ci nus5)pa dag gis de natshwa)bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa5nyebya ba'i phyir/ kha cig ni gser mang po'i char mngon par 'bebs so/ /kha cig ni dngulasadang / a ga ru dang ske/ rgya spos dang / go shir+ṣa dang / tsan danal 〉sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma dang ske/ ta ma la'i lo ma'i char dag mngon par 'bebs pa nas/ kha cig ni ut+pa la dang / me tog sna tshogs dang / ras bcos bu sna tshogs dang /63—788

gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs dang / gser skudatudang / mu tig gi⑧do shal gyi bar dag gi char mngon par 'bebs so/ de nas klu dang / klu chen po de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar bsnyebatud nas tshig 'thunasrepar 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar bdag cag ni dkon mchog gsum la sems shin tu legs par rab tu zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag cag 'di rnams kyis dam bca' bar bgyi ba ni btsun pa bcom ldan 'das grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs gang dngasnyigang dag na dpal me tog sar7pa zhes bgyi ༅ba'i gzungs chen po 'di rab tu sgrogasalgepa dang / de bzhin du gzungs lhag ma chu khyim snying po zhes bgyi ba dang /mtshon cha'i stobs zhes7bgyi ba dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan gyi smon lam gyi tshul zhes bgyi ba dang / nang gu dpal rdul 4)zhes bgyi ba dang /dpal me tog sar 8pa zhes bgyi 8ba'i gzungs chen po rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhis bshad pa'i gzungs de dag dang / klu'i7snying po bzhi po dag grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri brags kyi gnas gang dang gang dag tu re re tsam yang ston tam/ 'chad dam/ rab tu sgrogasacasam/ dran par bgyid pa de dang de dag tu bdag cag gis dus dus su char dbabatshwanyepa dang / gdugs dang / bser53ma dag gtong bar bgyi'o/ /dus ma lags par ni ma lags so/ /de dang der bdag cag gis phyi dgra dang /nang 'khrug〈nyedang / thabasko ༷ mo dang / rtsod pa dang / gnod sems dang /nad dang / mi ngas (medang / mu ge dag rab tu rtezhi bar bgyi lags so/ /de 63—789

dang der bdag cag gis skyid pa dang / lo legs pa dang / dga' bar 'gyur btudag bsgrub par bgyi lags so/ /de dang der sems can rnams kyi sa bon dang / myu gu dang / sdong bu dang / 'dabasnyem dang / me tog dang /'bras bu dang / shing dang / 'bru dang /ni sman dang / ro dag mi nyams par 'phel bar bgyi lags so/ /longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa0phal cher dri zhim pa dang / ro zhim pa dang / snum pa dang / 'jam pa dag tu bsgrub par bgyi lags so/ /bdag cag gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i rgyal po rnams kyang gcig la gcig byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang /'khonakhum mchis pa'i sems dang / rtsod pa ma mchis pa'i sems su bsgrub par bgyi lags so/ /de bzhin du bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u7rigs dang /dmangs7rigs dang / gnod sbyin rnams nas dge bsnyen dag gi bar dag tu byams pa'i sems dang ldan par bsgrub par tunyebagyi lags so/ /gang na gzungs chen po 'di rab tu sgrogs ⑩pa der ni 'phan tshun sems 'thun 8par bsgrub par〈nyebagyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu de dag thams cad la legs so legs so zhes bya ba gnang ngo / /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji snyed lhags pa rnams kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ri'i snying pos kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal lha mo chen mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dpal cho ga shes khyod la snying brtse tu 7ba'i grogs 'di dag yod na 'dir sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir da dung du ci'i phyir gdul ba'i tshogs rnams gzhugatshwanyepar mi nusayi/ dpal lha mo chen mos gsol pa/ byang chub sems 63—790

dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni smon lam gyi khyad par gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa thams cad du de lta bur skye ba len cing grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'thun ①pa de lta bu dag dang phrad pa thob lags so/ /da ltar bdag kyang grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'thun⑧pa khyod lta bu dang phrad pa lags so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang de'i lag tu thob ste/de'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug kyangakhubarjod par bgyi lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa/brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la shin tu gnas par blta bar bgyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpal cho ga shes khyod kyis ji skad smras pa de ltar yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni smon lam gyi khyad par gyis sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa thams cad du de lta bur skye ba len la/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po dag la brtson zhing der brtson pa brtan pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin no/ /grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen de lta bus yongs su zin pa yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de'i lag tu thob pa yin te/ de'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pakyiyang brjod par bya'o/ /des rnam par gnon pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /mngal gyi skyon las thar bar yang brjod par bya'o/ /mi slob pa'i sa la gnas pas zag pa zad par yang brjod par bya'o/ /de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis dgongs pa dang / byin gyis brlabs par yang brjod par bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa la shin tu gnas par yangashebarjod par bya'o/ /de nas 63—791

brgya byin gzitubarjid dri ma med pa bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa7bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir klu dang / klu chen po rnams sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dag la gnod par7bgyid lags/bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po rgyu dang / rkyen gnyis kyis 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir klu dang / klu chen po rnams sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang /yongs su spyod pa dag la gnod par byed do/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ 'dod chags kyi dbang dang / khro ba'i dbang gis dus ma yin pa'i sprin dag 'byung bar byed cing rdzisachar dang / ser drag dag 'bebs par byed do/ /lhags pa dang ske/ tsha ba dag 'byung bar byed do/ /des na 'dir sems can rnams kyi sa bon dang / myu gu dang / 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang /'bru dang / sman dang / ro dag tshig par byed do/ /skemasalgepar byed do/ /'brul7bar byed do/ /ma rungs par byed do/ / des na⑥sems can rnams longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dang mi ldan pas lus dang / ngag dang /yid kyis ⑩ sdig pa'i las mi bzad hu)pa rnam pa sna tshogs tunyedag kun tu spyod par byed do/ /las kyi sgrib pa mi bzad pa des na sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed tunyepa thams cad kyang sreg par byed do/ /skemasalgepar byed do/ /thal bar rlog par byed do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag spong zhing ngan song gsum po dag la gzhol bar byed do/ /kha cig gos dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba tsam gyi phyir tshe gcig gis de lta bur sdig pa'i las mtshams med pa dag gisnyibar du kun tu spyod par byed de / de bskal pa mang po zhig gi bar du phyir ⑩mir skye ba 63—792

'thobatupar mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te de dag yun ring po 'das nas brgya la brgya lam na mi'i lus thob na⑧yang kha cig ni yan lag nyams par 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni dran pa nyams par 'gyur ro/ /gdol pa'i rigs su yang skye bar 'gyur rol/ /g.yung po'i rigs dang / snyig mdzabamakhan gyi rigs dang / bkren pa dbul po'i rigs rnams su yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bza' ba dang btung ba'i longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa dag dang yang bral bar 'gyur la/ yang rgyu des na dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral nas7lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las kyi sgrib pa mi bzad pa dag kun tu spyod par byed do/ /yang kha cig ngan song gsum po dang / mnar med pa dag tu yang gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod pa dang mi ldan pa'i sems can rnams 'khor bar yun ring du nyam thag par 'gyur ro/ /ngan song gsum po dag tu sdug bsngal mi bzad pa sna tshogs dag nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ sdug bsngal gang cung zhuzad ci byung ba thams cad ni zas kyi rkyen las gyur pa lags te/ zas ma mchis na sdug bsngal 'byung ba yang ma mchis lags so/ /de nas de'i tshe brgya byin gzi brjid dri ma med pas tshigs su bcad de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sred ④pa'i dug gis bsgyur bas na/ /ngu ba dngasheni dgod7par bgyid/ /nye bar gnas shing ltung bar bgyid/ /kun tu spyod cing rnam par rgyug /sa gzhi dag la til brdungs ltar/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gnod par bgyid/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad la/ /derwa )ltar sred pas gnod par bgyid/ /kye ma srid pa'i57zhags pa yis/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i〈nyamathar gtugs pas/ /de ltar zhags 'di rgya che ba/ /kha zas dag gi hunyergyu 63—793

las byung / /so so'i skye bo rgyu gnyis kyi/ /sred pa'i rdul gyis yan lag bcings / /ri dgas7zhags pas bcings pa ltar/ /'bros pa dag tu nus ma lags / /lhar bcas 'jig rten sems can dag② /sred pas gar bgyid rtsol ba ltar/ /gar gzhung dag la gar mkhan brgyas / /de ni gar bgyid rtsol mi nus / /sredasnyipa'i dug gis bsgyur bas na/ /ji ltar skye bo myos pa ltar/ /btung ba myos bgyid bslad pa yis/ /myos pa dag tu mi bgyid do/ /sred pa'i gnod sbyin gdon dag gis/ /skye bo brlams nas 'khyal ba ltar/ /'byung po'i gdon gyis myos pa dag /'khyal ba dag tu mi bgyid do/ /nor 'dzin de dag 'dzin pa btang / /sred7pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par spangasame/ /gang gis sred pa bskams nas kyang / /de dag 'khor bar mi gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigasasridabang phyug gis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /zhe sdang khro bas skye dgutubarlams/ /sems kyang g.yeng 'gyur de yis na/ /dge ba thams cad mi 'tshal zhing / /bzod rlag las la spyod par bgyid/ /mi dge ba la gnas bgyid pa/ /pha ma dag la rim gro chung / /gang dag mtshams ma mchis bgyis hu ripa/ /dkon mchog gsum la brnyas07par bgyid/ /snying bcu7snying rje ma mchis pa/ /'jigs bgyid gtum po drag shul can/ /khro sems dbang gis de dag ni/ /sems dmyal mnar ma mchis par gnas/ /sems can 'di dag khro ba'i rgyus/ /gcig la gcig ni za bar bgyid/ /yang dang yang ni ngan song du / /sdug bsngal du mas rab tu gzir/ /sdig pa'i sems kyis brid gyur cing //dge ba'i bshes gnyen spangs nas kyang / /srid pa'i mtshor ni ltung ba ste/ /mun pa mun gnag〈rtegazhol ba po/ /de 'dra'i sems can don slad du/ /byang 63—794
